TEXT.English: Affinity
TEXT.French: Affinité

TEXT.English: [H1]Affinity[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Some creatures have affinity for a particular mana type. This means that they gain a strength bonus equal to their affinity amount for each source of that type of mana you control. So a creature that has Nature Affinity: 1 gets +1 for every nature mana you own. A creature with Death Affinity: 2 gets +2 strength for every death mana you control.
TEXT.French: [H1]Affinité[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Certaines créatures ont une affinité pour certains types de mana. Cela signifie qu'elles gagnent autant de force que le niveau d'affinité qu'elles possèdent pour chaque mana de ce type que vous contrôlez. Ainsi une créature qui a Affinité Nature: 1 gagnera 1 point de force pour chaque mana de nature contrôlée. une créature qui a Affinité Mort: 2 gagnera 2 point de force pour chaque mana de force contrôlée.
TEXT.German: [H1]Neigungen[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Einige Kreaturen besitzen eine Neigung für eine bestimmte Ausprägung des Manas. Sie erhalten einen Stärkebonus für jede Mana Ressource ihrer Neigung, die unter der Kontrolle des Spielers steht. Eine Kreatur mit einer Neigung für Mana der Natur: 1 bekommt einen Stärkebonus von +1 für jedes Mana der Natur, während eine Kreatur mit einer Neigung für Mana des Todes: 2 einen Stärkebonus von +2 für jedes Mana des Todes erhält.
TEXT.Italian: [H1]Affinity[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Some creatures have affinity for a particular mana type. This means that they gain a strength bonus equal to their affinity amount for each source of that type of mana you control. So a creature that has Nature Affinity: 1 gets +1 for every nature mana you own. A creature with Death Affinity: 2 gets +2 strength for every death mana you control.
TEXT.Spanish: [H1]Afinidad[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Algunas criaturas tienen una afinidad por un tipo concreto de maná. Esto es que obtienen una bonificación de fuerza igual a su cantidad de afinidad por cada fuente de ese tipo de maná que se controle. So a creature that has Nature Affinity: 1 gets +1 for every nature mana you own. A creature with Death Affinity: 2 gets +2 strength for every death mana you control.

TEXT.English: Armageddon Counter
TEXT.French: Compteur Armageddon

TEXT.English: [H1]The Armageddon Counter[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Armageddon counter goes up when bad things happen (cities are razed, the Ashen Veil is founded, an entropy node is built, etc) and down when good things happen (Mardero dies, The Ashen Veil holy city is razed, etc.). Depending on the civs in the game the Armageddon Counter either rises slowly over the course of the game, or tends to grow to about 20-40 and then levels off (assuming the player doesn't do anything to influence it).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]It affects many things, perhaps most notably, the spread of [LINK=CONCEPT_HELL_TERRAIN]Hell Terrain[\LINK].[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]So if hell is beginning to creep into your lands you have a few options to respond. Sending out some units to sack the Ashen Veil holy city would be an excellent way to get the Armageddon counter under control and to keep hell out of your lands. You could also gift tech, gold, or resources to a player that is at war with the Infernals if you wanted to contribute without getting into the war directly.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Armageddon counter also influences the chance that fire spreads to nearby tiles and the attitude modifier between good and evil civs. There is a promotion called Stigmata that gives the unit a percentage bonus equal to half the Armageddon counter as well as other mechanics that reward some players (especially the Sheaim) for having a high Armageddon count.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Since the alignment attitudes are influenced by the Armageddon count (getting better towards their own alignment and worse towards the opposed alignment) when the Armageddon count gets high huge good vs evil battles tend to break out.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notes: Functionally the AC serves to bring additional conflict to the end game. In Beyond the Sword Firaxis added espionage and corporations to address late game stagnancy. We were trying to solve the same problem but did it with the AC to try to bring conflict and a sense of urgency to the late game.
TEXT.French: [H1]Le Compteur Armageddon[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Le Compteur Armageddon augmente lorsque de mauvaises choses ont lieu ( villes rasées, Le Voile de Cendres fondé, un nœud d'entropie construit etc ) et diminue lorsque de bonnes choses ont lieu ( Mort de Mardero, ville sainte du Voile de Cendres rasée etc ). Selon les civilisations en jeu, le Compteur Armageddon soit monte lentement au cours de la partie, soit monte dans les 20-40 avant de stagner(Si le joueur ne fait rien pour l'influencer).[PARAGRAPH:1]It affects many things, perhaps most notably, the spread of [LINK=CONCEPT_HELL_TERRAIN]Hell Terrain[\LINK].[PARAGRAPH:1]Donc si l'enfer commence à apparaître sur vos terres, vous avez quelques possibilités de le contrer. Envoyer quelques unités piller la ville sainte du Voile de Cendres est un excellent moyen de garder le contrôle du Compteur Armageddon et de laisser les Enfers hors de vos frontières. You could also gift tech, gold, or resources to a player that is at war with the Infernals if you wanted to contribute without getting into the war directly.[PARAGRAPH:1]Le Compteur Armageddon influence aussi les chances que le feu se propage sur les cases proches et modifie les attitudes entre les civilisations du Bien et celles du Mal. La promotion Stigmate donne à une unité une pourcentage bonus égal à la moitié du compteur, et d'autres mécanismes avantagent certains joueurs (particulièrement les Sheaïms) pour avoir un haut compteur. Puisque les attitudes liées aux alignements sont influencées par le compteur Armageddon (meilleures relations avec ceux qui partagent votre alignement et moins bonnes avec ceux qui ont l'alignement opposé), lorsque celui-ci atteint de hautes valeurs, Des guerres dantesques du Bien contre le Mal ont des chances d'éclater.[PARAGRAPH:1]Notez que la plupart des contributions au Compteur Armageddon sont assignées au joueur. Cela a un impact sur les relations IA-Joueur.
TEXT.German: [H1]Der Armageddonzähler[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Der Armageddonzähler steigt, wenn schlimme Dinge passieren (Städte werden niedergebrannt, die Religion des Aschfahlen Schleiers wird gegründet, eine Quelle entropischer Manabrunnen wird gebaut, etc.) und sinkt wenn gute Dinge passieren (Mardero stirbt, die heilige Stadt des Aschfahlen Schleiers wird niedergebrannt). In Abhängigkeit der am Spiel teilnehmenden Zivilisationen steigt der Zähler entweder langsam aber kontinuierlich an, oder aber steigt auf 20-40 um dann wieder zu sinken.[PARAGRAPH:1]It affects many things, perhaps most notably, the spread of [LINK=CONCEPT_HELL_TERRAIN]Hell Terrain[\LINK].[PARAGRAPH:1]So, was kannst Du tun wenn sich die Hölle langsam aber sicher breit macht? Du hast ein paar Optionen. Zum einen kannst Du ein paar Einheiten ausschicken um die Heilige Stadt des Aschfahlen Schleiers dem Erdboden gleich zu machen. Das wäre ein hervorragender Weg dem Aschfahlen Schleier Einhalt zu gebieten und den Armageddonzähler unter Kontrolle zu bekommen. You could also gift tech, gold, or resources to a player that is at war with the Infernals if you wanted to contribute without getting into the war directly.[PARAGRAPH:1]Der Armageddonzähler beeinflusst auch die Möglichkeiten, dass sich Feuer auf Nachbarfelder ausbreitet und die Beziehungen zwischen den guten und den bösen Zivilisationen. Es gibt ferner eine Beförderung namens Stigmata die einen prozentualen Bonus auf die Stärke einer Einheit, entsprechend der Hälfte des Armageddon-Zähler verleiht sowie andere Mechanismen die einige Zivilisationen (im speziellem die Sheaim) bei einem hohen Stand des Zählers belohnen.[PARAGRAPH:1]Dadurch dass ein Ansteigen des Zählers eine Verschlechterung der Beziehungen von bösen und guten Zivilisationen zur Folge hat, steigt mit dem Zähler gleichzeitig die Wahrscheinlichkeit eines Krieges zwischen diesen beiden Anschauungen.[PARAGRAPH:1]Beachte das der größte Anteil am Verhalten des Zählers beim Spieler liegt. Dies hat einen Einfluss auf die Ai-Spieler Beziehungen.
TEXT.Italian: [H1]The Armageddon Counter[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Armageddon counter goes up when bad things happen (cities are razed, the Ashen Veil is founded, an entropy node is built, etc) and down when good things happen (Mardero dies, The Ashen Veil holy city is razed, etc.). Depending on the civs in the game the Armageddon Counter either rises slowly over the course of the game, or tends to grow to about 20-40 and then levels off (assuming the player doesn't do anything to influence it).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]It affects many things, perhaps most notably, the spread of [LINK=CONCEPT_HELL_TERRAIN]Hell Terrain[\LINK].[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]So if hell is beginning to creep into your lands you have a few options to respond. Sending out some units to sack the Ashen Veil holy city would be an excellent way to get the Armageddon counter under control and to keep hell out of your lands. You could also gift tech, gold, or resources to a player that is at war with the Infernals if you wanted to contribute without getting into the war directly.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Armageddon counter also influences the chance that fire spreads to nearby tiles and the attitude modifier between good and evil civs. There is a promotion called Stigmata that gives the unit a percentage bonus equal to half the Armageddon counter as well as other mechanics that reward some players (especially the Sheaim) for having a high Armageddon count.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Since the alignment attitudes are influenced by the Armageddon count (getting better towards their own alignment and worse towards the opposed alignment) when the Armageddon count gets high huge good vs evil battles tend to break out.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notes: Functionally the AC serves to bring additional conflict to the end game. In Beyond the Sword Firaxis added espionage and corporations to address late game stagnancy. We were trying to solve the same problem but did it with the AC to try to bring conflict and a sense of urgency to the late game.
TEXT.Spanish: [H1]El Contador del Armagedón[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]El contador del Armagedón aumenta cuando ocurren cosas malas (ciudades arrasadas, fundación del Velo Ceniciento, se construye un nodo de Entropía, etc) y disminuye cuando pasan cosas buenas (Mardero muere, la ciudad santa del Velo Ceniciento es arrasada, etc). Dependiendo de las civilizaciones en el juego el Contador del Armagedón puede ir aumentando lentamente a lo largo de la partida, o tiende a crecer a 20-40 y después disminuye (asumiendo que el jugador(es) no hace nada para influir en él).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]It affects many things, perhaps most notably, the spread of [LINK=CONCEPT_HELL_TERRAIN]Hell Terrain[\LINK].[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Así que si el infierno empieza a tocar las tierras de un jugador, éste tiene pocas opciones para responder. Enviar unidades fuera a saquear la ciudad santa del Velo Ceniciento sería una manera excelente para llevar al Contador del Armagedón a niveles aceptables y mantener al infierno fuera de sus tierras. You could also gift tech, gold, or resources to a player that is at war with the Infernals if you wanted to contribute without getting into the war directly.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]El contador del Armagedón también afecta a la probabilidad de que el fuego se propague por casillas cercanas y al modificador de actitud entre civilizaciones buenas y malvadas. Hay un ascenso llamado Estigma que da a la unidad una bonificación de porcentaje igual a la mitad del contador del Armagedón así como otras adiciones que recompensan a algunos jugadores (especialmente a los Sheaim) por haber un contador alto del Armagedón.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Así como las actitudes de alineamiento son influenciadas por el contador del Armagedón (siendo mejor hacia los del propio alineamiento y peor hacia los de alineamiento opuesto) cuando el Contador del Armagedón sea alto tenderán a haber gigantescas batallas entre el bien y el mal.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Notas de Kael: Funcionalmente el CA sirve para traer conflictos adicionales al final del juego. En Beyond the Sword, Firaxis añadió espionaje y corporaciones para acabar un poco con el estancamiento de esa parte del juego. Estuvimos intentanto resolver el mismo problema y lo hicimos con el CA para intentar traer conflictos y una sensación de emergencia al final del juego.

TEXT.English: Crime Rate
TEXT.French: Taux de criminalité

TEXT.English:
[H1]Crime Rate[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Crime is a value that accumulates in your cities each turn based on population and buildings. When the Crime Rate reaches certain levels in your cities, some crimes become widespread. This produces various effects, both positive and negative, depending on the crime. Letting the crime rate run unchecked may put harm on your city and economy.
Each unit of population increases the per-turn crime rate by two, so crime rate will steadily increase as your city grows. Access to Chaos mana increases the crime rate by two (more chaos will not increase it further). Many buildings increase crime rate per-turn, such as the Gambling House, Smuggler's Port, or the Bazaar of Mammon.
Some buildings set the minimum crime of your city to a particular number. These include the Thieves' Den, Thieves' Guild, and Poisoner's Workshop buildings. These are very helpful if you want the benefits of a certain level of crime within a city.
In general, 'too high' crime is 650, as Arson reduces hammers which is harsh. 900 crime's 'Corruption' gives you crime-per-population which almost certainly means it will spiral out of control.
To reduce crime, and some examples: Buildings: Courthouses, dungeons, walls, garrison quarters Religious Buildings: Kilmorph, White Hand, Empyrean, and especially Order Basic Patrol Promotions: Melee Advanced Patrol Promotions: Defensive Melee, Archers Others: Golden Age, Civics, Martial Law
As a last resort the city can go into Martial Law (Unlocked at Code of Laws), resulting in the city not directly building anything but working on reducing its crime.
The Penal Colony is a unique national wonder which will half crime in all your cities except the city with the Penal Colony building. The Penal Colony city will itself get a huge influx of crime (+50), but gets hammers per active crime, gets a hefty food bonus, and builds units with a free patrol which can help mitigate some of that crime. It is very strong, but be careful when and where you build it as 50 is a lot of crime to suddenly dump into a city.
In the other direction, crime can be made to work for you. The poisoner's workshop boosts science in the city, for example, and some crimes are purely or mostly positive such as Illegal Immigration.
Making Crime work for you: Crime-focused Civs: Cualli, and especially Lanun. Both of these have unique crimes that are more helpful than not. Lanun also have buildings which will help based on how many crimes you have. Keep your crime at 400 for Cualli, or 300 for Lanun.
Council of Esus religion: Removes the happiness penalty from crimes,and gives some buildings that are helpful. Swapping to Esus may make a crime-addled city back to being functional.
Good Civs for Crime: Lanun, Cualli, Austrin, Hippus Poor Civs for Crime: Clan of Embers, Balseraphs, Khazad, Kuriotates, Scions of Patria.

TEXT.English: Barbarians
TEXT.French: Barbarians

TEXT.English: [H1]Barbarians[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Barbarians in Ashes of Erebus are separated into three factions: [LINK=CIVILIZATION_ANIMAL]Cernunnos'[\LINK] Animals, [LINK=CIVILIZATION_DEMON]Agares'[\LINK] Demons, and [LINK=CIVILIZATION_ORC]Bhall's[\LINK] Savages. A civilization or specific leader can be allied with one of them but still have to contend with the others. For instance, the [LINK=TRAIT_HORDE]Horde[\LINK] trait makes peace with Bhall, and [LINK=TRAIT_FERAL]Feral[\LINK] trait or completing the [LINK=PROJECT_NATURES_REVOLT]Nature's Revolt[\LINK] ritual will make peace with Cernunos. The [LINK=CIVILIZATION_SHEAIM]Sheaim[\LINK] can make peace with Agares by simply adopting [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]Ashen Veil[\LINK], while others must do the same but also complete the diabolic [LINK=PROJECT_PAX_DIABOLIS]Pax Diabolis[\LINK] ritual; this may be necessary if the world is entering [LINK=CONCEPT_ARMAGEDDON_COUNTER]Armageddon[\LINK]![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Mechanically, Barbarians present much more of a threat in Erebus than in Civilization IV; if unprepared or unlucky, it is entirely possible for a civilization to meet its downfall at the hands of these factions. One important control for the barbarian faction is the game difficulty setting. The density of barbarians found in the wild (and the number of Savage cities) starts off quite low on Settler, but increases as the difficulty raises up until the level of Monarch. At this difficulty, further increases to the difficulty setting will not increase the density of barbarians, but the AI will continue to be stronger against them. If you desire more, the custom gameoptions of Raging Barbarians, Barbarian World, and Wild Animals will all increase the density of barbarians found in the wild. For additional mechanics related to barbarians, see [LINK=CONCEPT_LAIRS]Lairs[\LINK].

For additional mechanics related to barbarians, see [LINK=CONCEPT_LAIRS]Lairs[\LINK].
TEXT.German: [H1]Barbarians[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Barbarians in Ashes of Erebus are separated into three factions: [LINK=CIVILIZATION_ANIMAL]Cernunnos'[\LINK] Animals, [LINK=CIVILIZATION_DEMON]Agares'[\LINK] Demons, and [LINK=CIVILIZATION_ORC]Bhall's[\LINK] Savages. A civilization or specific leader can be allied with one of them but still have to contend with the others. For instance, the [LINK=TRAIT_HORDE]Horde[\LINK] trait makes peace with Bhall, and [LINK=TRAIT_FERAL]Feral[\LINK] trait or completing the [LINK=PROJECT_NATURES_REVOLT]Nature's Revolt[\LINK] ritual will make peace with Cernunos. The [LINK=CIVILIZATION_SHEAIM]Sheaim[\LINK] can make peace with Agares by simply adopting [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]Ashen Veil[\LINK], while others must do the same but also complete the diabolic [LINK=PROJECT_PAX_DIABOLIS]Pax Diabolis[\LINK] ritual; this may be necessary if the world is entering [LINK=CONCEPT_ARMAGEDDON_COUNTER]Armageddon[\LINK]![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Mechanically, Barbarians present much more of a threat in Erebus than in Civilization IV; if unprepared or unlucky, it is entirely possible for a civilization to meet its downfall at the hands of these factions. One important control for the barbarian faction is the game difficulty setting. The density of barbarians found in the wild (and the number of Savage cities) starts off quite low on Settler, but increases as the difficulty raises up until the level of Monarch. At this difficulty, further increases to the difficulty setting will not increase the density of barbarians, but the AI will continue to be stronger against them. If you desire more, the custom gameoptions of Raging Barbarians, Barbarian World, and Wild Animals will all increase the density of barbarians found in the wild. For additional mechanics related to barbarians, see [LINK=CONCEPT_LAIRS]Lairs[\LINK].

TEXT.English: Defensive Strike
TEXT.French: Frappe défensive

TEXT.English: [H1]Defensive Strikes[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Whenever any unit attacks the game checks for any enemy unit with defensive strike in the defending stack. Only units with Blitz or haven't attacked can make defensive strikes. Each unit that qualifies has a chance equal to his defensive strike chance to be able to make the attack. If multiple defending units can make a defensive strike only the one that does the most damage is used (so an attacking unit will only face one strike).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A defensive strike does an average of the unit's Defensive Strike damage. But it is randomized and could be as little as 0 damage or twice that average. The number is modified based on the attacking unit's defensive strength and level and the unit performing the defensive strike is marked as having attacked.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]For example:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A level 4 Clan of Embers champion with bronze weapons (str 7) attacks a stack with a Bannor champion and three Malakim longbowmen, one of the longbowmen has Drill 1 and Drill 2. The clan is at war with both the Bannor and the Malakim, since the Bannor champion has higher defensive strength he is selected to defend. None of the Malakim Longbowmen have attacked so they are all valid for defensive strikes. The three individually check to see if they can make a defensive strike with (30%, 30% and 50%) and one of the normal longbowmen and the one with drill 1 and 2 both succeed.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The game takes the longbowman with drill 1 and 2 because he can do more damage (average 25 instead of average 15). The game rolls on the average 25 (0-50 weighted toward the middle) and comes up with 34 damage. The Clan of Embers Champion subtracts double his level (8) and double is defensive strength (14) so the damage is reduced from 34 to 12.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Clan of Embers champion takes 12% damage and then fights the Bannor champion as normal.

The clan is at war with both the Bannor and the Malakim, since the Bannor champion has higher defensive strength he is selected to defend. The game rolls on the average 25 (0-50 weighted toward the middle) and comes up with 34 damage. The Clan of Embers Champion subtracts double his level (8) and double is defensive strength (14) so the damage is reduced from 34 to 12.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Clan of Embers champion takes 12% damage and then fights the Bannor champion as normal.
TEXT.German: [H1]Defensivschlag[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Immer wenn eine Einheit angreift, prüft das Spiel, ob im verteidigenden Einheitenverband eine feindliche Einheit über die Fähigkeit "Defensivschlag" verfügt. Nur Einheiten mit der Beförderung "Blitzangriff" oder solche, die noch nicht angegriffen haben, können einen Defensivschlag durchführen. Jede geeignete Einheit hat eine Chance, die ihrer Chance zum Defensivschlag entspricht, den Angriff durchzuführen. Falls mehrere verteidigende Einheiten einen Defensivschlag ausführen können, wird nur diejenige eingesetzt, die den meisten Schaden verursacht (also erhält eine angreifende Einheit nur einen Schlag).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Ein Defensivschlag verursacht nur einen gemittelten Schaden, der durch den Defensivschlag der Einheit möglich ist. Dieser Schadenswert ist zufällig und könnte nur 0 oder das Doppelte des Mittelwerts betragen. Der Wert wird durch die Verteidigungsstärke der angreifenden Einheit und deren Stufe modifiziert und die Einheit, die den Defensivschlag ausführt, kann in der nachfolgenden Runde keinen weiteren Angriff durchführen.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Beispiel:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Ein Champion der Stufe 4 des Klans der Asche mit Bronzewaffen (Stärke 7) greift eine Einheitenverband mit einem bannorischen Champion und drei malakimischen Langbogenschützen an, einer der Langbogenschützen verfügt über die Beförderungen "Erstschlag I" und "Erstschlag II". Der Klan ist im Krieg mit sowohl den Bannor als auch den Malakim. Da der bannorische Champion über die höhere Verteidigungsstärke verfügt, wird er für die Verteidigung gewählt. Keiner der malakimischen Langbogenschützen hat angegriffen, so dass sie alle für einen Defensivschlag in Frage kommen. Die drei werden einzeln geprüft, mit welcher Wahrscheinlichkeit sie einen Defensivschlag ausführen können (30%, 30% und 50%), und einer der normalen Langbogenschützen und jener mit Erstschlag I und II sind dabei erfolgreich.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Das Spiel wählt den Langbogenschützen mit Erstschlag I und II, weil er mehr Schaden verursacht (durchschnittlich 25 statt durchschnittlich 15). Das Spiel würfelt mit den durchschnittlich 25 (0-50 gewichtet zum Mittel) und erhält einen Schaden von 34. Der Champion des Klans zieht davon das Doppelte seiner Stufe (8) und das Doppelte seiner Verteidigungsstärke (14) ab, so dass der Schaden von 34 auf 12 gesenkt wird.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Der Champion des Klans der Asche nimmt 12% Schaden und kämpft dann wie gewohnt gegen den bannorischen Champion.

The clan is at war with both the Bannor and the Malakim, since the Bannor champion has higher defensive strength he is selected to defend. TEXT.English: Equipment
TEXT.French: Équipement

TEXT.English: [H1]Equipment[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Equipment is a special object type in Fall from Heaven. It can be presented as a promotion on a unit that is carrying it, or as a non-moveable unit itself when it is sitting in a tile. Some pieces of Equipment can also be used as a building in a city. The chief difference between equipment and other promotions is that if a unit with a piece of equipment is killed that equipment is dropped into the tile the unit died in, rather than being lost.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notes: Although the equipment system allows modders to manufacture entire arsenals of swords, shields and bows for their armies our goal with Equipment is to use it only for rare powerful artifacts with significant strategic impact. We do this to avoid micromanagement and to maintain the special allure of capturing a piece of equipment.
TEXT.French: [H1]Équipement[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]L'équipement est un type d'objet spécial dans Fall from Heaven. Il peut se présenter sous la forme d'une promotion sur l'unité qui le porte, ou comme une unité incapable de bouger, quand il est laissé sur une case. Certains équipements peuvent être utilisés comme bâtiments dans une ville. La différence principale entre un équipement et les autres promotions est qui si une unité portant un équipement est tuée cet équipement est laissé sur la case que l'unité occupait, plutot que d'être perdu.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Note de Kael: Bien que le système d'équipement permet aux moddeurs de créer un immense arsenal d'épées, de boucliers et d'arcs pour leurs armées notre but avec l'équipement est de l'utiliser uniquement pour des artefacts rares et puissants, avec un impact stratégique significatif.Nous faisons cela pour éviter la micro-gestion et pour garder l'importance de la capture d'un équipement.
TEXT.German: [H1]Ausrüstung[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Ausrüstungsgegenstände sind besondere Objekte in Fall from Heaven. Sie können als Beförderungen für Einheiten die diese tragen oder als nicht bewegbare Einheit auf einem Geländefeld angesehen werden. Einige Ausrüstungsgegenstände können auch als Gebäude in einer Stadt eingesetzt werden. Der Hauptunterschied zwischen Ausrüstungsgegenständen und anderen Beförderungen liegt in der Handhabung nach dem Ableben einer Einheit. Anstatt aufgelöst zu werden wird der Ausrüstungsgegenstand auf dem jeweiligen Geländefeld fallen gelassen und kann von anderen Einheiten wieder genutzt werden.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notiz: Obwohl es dieses System einigen Moddern erlaubt ein ganzes Arsenal an Schwertern, Schilden und Bögen für ihre Armee anzufertigen ist es unsere Intention Ausrüstungsgegenstände nur als seltene sehr mächtige Artefakte einzusetzen, wobei ihnen hierbei eine wichtige strategische Rolle zukommt. Dies soll Micromanagment verhindern und den speziellen Reiz der Eroberung solcher Artefakte erhalten.
TEXT.Italian: [H1]Equipment[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Equipment is a special object type in Fall from Heaven. It can be presented as a promotion on a unit that is carrying it, or as a non-moveable unit itself when it is sitting in a tile. Some pieces of Equipment can also be used as a building in a city. The chief difference between equipment and other promotions is that if a unit with a piece of equipment is killed that equipment is dropped into the tile the unit died in, rather than being lost.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notes: Although the equipment system allows modders to manufacture entire arsenals of swords, shields and bows for their armies our goal with Equipment is to use it only for rare powerful artifacts with significant strategic impact. We do this to avoid micromanagement and to maintain the special allure of capturing a piece of equipment.
TEXT.Spanish: [H1]Equipo[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]El equipo es un tipo de objeto especial en Fall from Heaven. Puede estar representado en forma de ascenso en una unidad que lo lleva, o como una unidad no trasladable cuando esta asentada en una casilla. Algunas piezas de Equipo pueden usarse también como un edificio en una ciudad. La principal diferencia entre el equipo y otros ascensos es que si una unidad con una pieza de equipo es destruida ese equipo cae al suelo al mismo tiempo que la unidad muere, en lugar de perderse.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Notas de Kael: Aunque el sistema de equipos permite a los modders crear un arsenal entero de espadas, escudos y arcos para sus ejércitos nuestro objetivo con el Equipo es usarlo sólo para artefactos raros y poderosos con un significante impacto estratégico. Hacemos esto para evitar el micromanejo y mantener el especial encanto de capturar piezas de equipo.

TEXT.English: Emergent and Important Leaders
TEXT.French: Emergent and Important Leaders

TEXT.English: [H1]Non-Historical Leaders[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Leaders with the Emergent and Important tag are able to gain new bonuses as they play, effectively gaining "XP" from performing tasks in an ongoing game, when they gain enough XP they will unlock these new traits for that playthrough (note these requirements scale up and down based on the size of map and game speed selected).[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]To see what actions will give experience towards traits, you can check the star shaped button in the top left corner while playing.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Remember that any leader can only have up to 3 traits under normal circumstances, although mechanics like the Elohim's [LINK=CONCEPT_ELOHIM_KEEPERS_OF_SACRED_PLACES]Keeper[\LINK] Traits, Pact with the Infernal Traits, or civilization traits like [LINK=TRAIT_HORSELORD]Hippus Horselord[\LINK] can bypass the 3 trait limit.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H2]Important Leaders[\H2][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Important leaders are able to earn other normal traits such as trader, warlord, aggressive and so on by performing the tasks associated with that trait. (EG: trading resources, gold or maps with other civs will work towards the [LINK=TRAIT_TRADER]Trader[\LINK] trait.)[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Important leaders who earn enough XP to gain a trait are first asked if they wish to take that trait as their reward, if they say no then that traits XP will reset to 0.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Emergent Leaders[\H1][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Emergent leaders level up a trait unique to them, gaining new and more powerful bonuses on each level up.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Emergent traits have 3 levels.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Each level requires more experience than the previous. (these requirements scale up and down based on the size of map and game speed selected.)[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You can find the later levels of an Emergent trait listed in the Traits Civilopedia page.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Miscellaneous[\H1][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]A small subsect of emergent leaders break these rules([LINK=LEADER_KAHD]Kahd[\LINK]/Some module leaders) but for the most part the above will hold true.

TEXT.Spanish: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Leaders with the Emergent and Important tag are able to gain new bonuses as they play, effectively gaining "XP" from performing tasks in an ongoing game, when they gain enough XP they will unlock these new traits for that playthrough (these requirements scale up and down based on the size of map and game speed selected).[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]To see what actions will give experience towards traits, you can check the star shaped button in the top left corner while playing.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Remember that any leader can only have up to 3 traits under normal circumstances, although mechanics like the Elohim's [LINK=CONCEPT_ELOHIM_KEEPERS_OF_SACRED_PLACES]Keeper[\LINK] Traits, Pact with the Infernal Traits, or civilization traits like [LINK=TRAIT_HORSELORD]Hippus Horselord[\LINK] can bypass the 3 trait limit.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Important Leaders[\H1][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Important leaders are able to earn other normal traits such as trader, warlord, aggressive and so on by performing the tasks associated with that trait. (EG: trading resources, gold or maps with other civs will work towards the [LINK=TRAIT_TRADER]Trader[\LINK] trait.)[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Important leaders who earn enough XP to gain a trait are first asked if they wish to take that trait as their reward, if they say no then that traits XP will reset to 0.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Emergent Leaders[\H1][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Emergent leaders level up a trait unique to them, gaining new and more powerful bonuses on each level up.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Emergent traits have 3 levels.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Each level requires more experience than the previous. (these requirements scale up and down based on the size of map and game speed selected.)[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]You can find the later levels of an Emergent trait listed in the Traits Civilopedia page.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Miscellaneous[\H1][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]A small subsect of emergent leaders break these rules([LINK=LEADER_KAHD]Kahd[\LINK]/Some module leaders) but for the most part the above will hold true.

TEXT.English: Commanders
TEXT.French: Commanders

TEXT.English: [H1]Commanders[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]In addition to great commanders, some civilizations have other units with commander capacity such as the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_BANNOR]Bannor[\LINK] and [LINK=CIVILIZATION_CLAN_OF_EMBERS]Clan of Embers[\LINK]. However, they all obey similar rules:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Units assigned to a commander gain all commander buffs that apply to their unit class. For instance, Archers have the archer unit class and benefit from promotions like [LINK=PROMOTION_GC_ARCHERY_COMMANDER1]Archery Commander I[\LINK].[ICON_BULLET]Commanders gain 25% of whatever experience their commanded units gain from combat. However, The commander's experience gain is diminished with every 10 experience points of difference between commander and commanded unit, meaning that lower level commanded units give higher level commanders less experience, and higher level commanded units also give less experience to low level commanders.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Because great commanders start with a command cap of 3 (75% xp, assuming xp is shared roughly equally among the commanded units) they will eventually fall behind if assigned to three units of the same level, so consider taking a +1 command limit promotion to help the commander keep up if the first thing you do is assign them to fresh units.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Commanders have a value known as command range, this is how far away the unit can be from the commander and still benefit from the command promotions. A value of 0 means that the commander only effects units on the same tile, a value of 1 means it effects units within 1 tile radius, and so on. A unit outside of command range does not share experience with their commander.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Noteworthy commanders and factions include:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][LINK=UNIT_COMMANDER]Great Commanders[\LINK] are the standard commander for most factions.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The [LINK=CIVILIZATION_BANNOR]Bannor[\LINK], who make heavy use of command promotions and a special chain of command system to bolster their troops.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][LINK=LEADER_JAMAL]Jamal Dahkar[\LINK] of the Mekara, makes heavy use of commanders to empower [LINK=UNIT_SLUGA_V2]Slugas[\LINK] and regular units.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][LINK=UNIT_AURIC]Auric[\LINK], of the Illians as he leads his people towards regaining their birthright.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][LINK=UNIT_ZARCAZ]Zarcaz[\LINK] of the Savages. He doesn't start off particularly scary, but his command ability helps him stay alive and become a major force multiplier as time goes on. Do not underestimate him!

TEXT.English: Forts
TEXT.French: Forts

TEXT.English: [H1]Forts[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Forts grow into castles and eventually citadels. The effects of each upgrade are as follows:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Fort: Gives +10% defense to anyone in the tile and +5% defense to allies within a 1 plot range[NEWLINE]Castle- gives +25% defense and +10% heal rate to anyone in the tile and a +10% defense to allies within a 2 plot range[NEWLINE]Citadel- gives +40% defense, +20% heal rate and +1 visibility to anyone in the tile and a +15% defense to allies within a 3 plot range[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]These defensive range bonuses are disabled if an enemy unit occupies the fort.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notes: The AI has been adjusted to scatter the occasional Fort around, but never clump them together (this was the hardest part of setting up this system). Since we link into the terrain defense modifier system (the same system that says hills and forests grant defense bonuses) the AI does a good job of preferring to move through tiles that have "fort cover". We also tweaked the AI so that in times of war it will station units in forts to maintain the bonus.
TEXT.French: [H1]Forts[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Nous avons un design complètement nouveau pour les forts. Maintenant, ils commencent en tant que forts, puis évoluent en chateau, et enfin éventuellement en citadelle. Les effets de chaque améliorations sont les suivants:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Fort- donne +10% en defense aux unités sur la case et +5% en defense aux alliés dans un rayon d'une case[NEWLINE]Chateau- donne +25% en defense et +10% au taux de soin aux unités sur la case et +10% en defense aux alliés dans un rayon de deux cases[NEWLINE]Citadelle- donne +40% defense, +20% au taux de soin et +1 en visibilité aux unités sur la case et +15% en defense aux alliés dans un rayon de trois cases[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Au bout d'un certain temps, les tours antiques se transforment en chateau. Les bonus de défense dans un rayon de quelques cases sont annulés si l'ennemi occupe le fort.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Note de Kael: L'IA a été ajustée pour disperser quelques forts aux alentours, mais ne les massera jamais ensemble (C'était la partie la plus difficile du système à installer). Puisque nous avons travaillé sur le système des bonus de défense des terrains(Le système qui fait que les collines et les forêts donnent des bonus de défense) l'IA préfère se déplacer sur des cases protégées par les forts . Elle est aussi réglée pour qu'en temps des guerre ses unités stationnent dans les forts pour garder les bonus.
TEXT.German: [H1]Festungen[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Das Konzept von Befestigungsanlagen wurde komplett neu gestaltet. Befestigungsanlagen starten als Festung wachsen zu Schlössern und anschließend zu Zitadellen. Die Effekte der Verbesserungen sind dabei wie folgt:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Festungen geben +10% Verteidigung für Einheiten in der Festung und +5% Verteidigung für verbündete Einheiten in einem Radius von einem Feld[NEWLINE]Schlösser geben +25% Verteidigung und +10% Heilungsrate für Einheiten in dem Schloss und +10% Verteidigung für verbündete Einheiten in einem Radius von zwei Feldern[NEWLINE]Zitadellen geben +40% Verteidigung, +20% Heilungsrate und +1 Sichtweite für Einheiten in der Zitadelle und +15% Verteidigung für verbündete Einheiten in einem Radius von drei Feldern[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Nach genügender Zeit werden uralte Türme zu Schlössern aufgewertet. Der Verteidigungsbonus um die Befestigungsanlage entfällt, wenn sie von feindliche Einheiten kontrolliert wird.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notiz: Wir haben der KI beigebracht, ein paar Forts wild verteilt zu bauen, ohne sie anzuhäufen (das war der komplizierteste Teil). Weil wir die KI auf den Verteidigungsbonus von Forts hinweisen (wie es mit den Verteidigungsboni von Hügeln und Wäldern gemacht wird), schafft sie es, bevorzugt auf Felder mit Fort-Bonus zu ziehen. Ausserdem wird die KI in Kriegszeiten Einheiten in Forts stationieren.
TEXT.Italian: [H1]Forts[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Forts grow into castles and eventually citadels. The effects of each upgrade are as follows:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Fort- gives +10% defense to anyone in the tile and +5% defense to allies within a 1 plot range[NEWLINE]Castle- gives +25% defense and +10% heal rate to anyone in the tile and a +10% defense to allies within a 2 plot range[NEWLINE]Citadel- gives +40% defense, +20% heal rate and +1 visibility to anyone in the tile and a +15% defense to allies within a 3 plot range[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]These defensive range bonuses are disabled if an enemy unit occupies the fort.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notes: The AI has been adjusted to scatter the occasional Fort around, but never clump them together (this was the hardest part of setting up this system). Since we link into the terrain defense modifier system (the same system that says hills and forests grant defense bonuses) the AI does a good job of preferring to move through tiles that have "fort cover". We also tweaked the AI so that in times of war it will station units in forts to maintain the bonus.
TEXT.Spanish: [H1]Fuertes[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Tenemos un enteramente nuevo diseño de fuertes. Ahora empiezan como fuertes, entonces crecen hasta ser castillos y más tarde ciudadelas. Los efectos de cada mejora son los siguientes:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Fuerte: da +10% de defensa a todos en la casilla y +5% de defensa a los aliados a 1 casilla de distancia[NEWLINE]Castillo: da +25% de defensa y +10% de ratio de curación a todo aquel en la casilla y un +10% de defensa a los aliados en un radio de 2 casillas de distancia[NEWLINE]Ciudadela: da +40% de defensa, +20% al ratio de curación y +1 de visibilidad a todos en la casilla y un +15% de defensa a las unidades aliadas en un radio de 3 casillas[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Ahora con tiempo suficiente, las torres antiguas son mejoradas a castillos. Estas bonificaciones de alcance de defensa son desactivadas si una unidad enemiga ocupa el fuerte.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Notas de Kael: La IA ha sido ajustada para dispersar de forma ocasional fuertes alrededor, pero nunca a colocarlos cerca unos de otros (esta fue la parte más difícil para poner a punto este sistema). Desde entonces conectamos con el sistema de modificador de defensa por terreno (el mismo sistema que dice que las colinas y los bosques dan bonificaciones defensivas) la Ia hace un buen trabajo al preferir moverse por casillas con "cobertura de fuertes". También retocamos la IA de forma que en tiempos de guerra estacione unidades en los fuertes para mantener la bonificación.

TEXT.English: Hell Terrain
TEXT.French: Enfer

TEXT.English: [H1]Hell Terrain[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Land touched by the infernal twists and corrupts, creating many issues for the living beings of Erebus such as lowering yields from the land, twisting resources into alternate forms, and spewing forth Agares' Demons. While it spreads slower over water, much slower over mountains, and never into [LINK=PLOT_EFFECT_BLESSED_LANDS]Blessed Lands[\LINK], as the [LINK=CONCEPT_ARMAGEDDON_COUNTER]Armageddon Counter (AC)[\LINK] rises, sources of infernal corruption will begin to spread this terrain faster and further:[PARAGRAPH:1]AC 20: Hell terrain spawned by the Infernals themselves will begin to spread without range restriction across unowned tiles.[PARAGRAPH:1]AC 40: With the first Horseman, Hell terrain will spread without restriction through the lands of Evil-Aligned civs.[PARAGRAPH:1]AC 60: Hell terrain spreads freely through the tiles of Neutral-Aligned civs.[PARAGRAPH:1]AC 80: With Armageddon looming, even Good-Aligned civs will suffer the effects of Hell spreading freely through their territory.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Note that these thresholds are explicitly for spreading *infinitely* through owned tiles; the intrusive nature of Infernal corruption will push some distance into owned tiles regardless of the AC. However, hell terrain is not static with respect to these barriers, in that as a city pushes its culture deeper into hell terrain, tiles deeper into the culture may find the hell terrain recede.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]In addition to these breakpoints for hell spreading infinitely through owned territory, a higher AC allows other sources besides Infernals to spread further. At first, only the most cursed locations on the map will spread infinitely, starting from about AC 40. By AC 80, most sources will spread infinitely. Note however that the spread of hell terrain, until it surpasses the AC threshold to allow it to spread infinitely from that source, is intrinsically linked to that source. For example: At AC 0 [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BRADELINES_WELL]Bradeline's Well[\LINK] will curse the tile it's on. By AC 20, it will spread to several tiles surrounding it (range depending on mapsize, as with all Hell terrain effects). At any point up to this, if [LINK=SPELL_SANCTIFY]Sanctify[\LINK] is used to purify the *tile* of the well, all tiles it is directly cursing will begin to slowly restore. However, once the AC hits a certain threshold, the level of corruption becomes self-sustaining, and every tile cursed by Bradeline's Well will need to be sanctified, not just the origin itself!

TEXT.Italian: [H1]Hell Terrain[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Land touched by the infernal twists and corrupts, creating many issues for the living beings of Erebus such as lowering yields from the land, twisting resources into alternate forms, and spewing forth Agares' Demons. While it spreads slower over water, much slower over mountains, and never into [LINK=PLOT_EFFECT_BLESSED_LANDS]Blessed Lands[\LINK], as the [LINK=CONCEPT_ARMAGEDDON_COUNTER]Armageddon Counter (AC)[\LINK] rises, sources of infernal corruption will begin to spread this terrain faster and further:[PARAGRAPH:1]AC 20: Hell terrain spawned by the Infernals themselves will begin to spread without range restriction across unowned tiles.[PARAGRAPH:1]AC 40: With the first Horseman, Hell terrain will spread without restriction through the lands of Evil-Aligned civs.[PARAGRAPH:1]AC 60: Hell terrain spreads freely through the tiles of Neutral-Aligned civs.[PARAGRAPH:1]AC 80: With Armageddon looming, even Good-Aligned civs will suffer the effects of Hell spreading freely through their territory.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Note that these thresholds are explicitly for spreading *infinitely* through owned tiles; the intrusive nature of Infernal corruption will push some distance into owned tiles regardless of the AC. However, hell terrain is not static with respect to these barriers, in that as a city pushes its culture deeper into hell terrain, tiles deeper into the culture may find the hell terrain recede.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]In addition to these breakpoints for hell spreading infinitely through owned territory, a higher AC allows other sources besides Infernals to spread further. At first, only the most cursed locations on the map will spread infinitely, starting from about AC 40. By AC 80, most sources will spread infinitely. Note however that the spread of hell terrain, until it surpasses the AC threshold to allow it to spread infinitely from that source, is intrinsically linked to that source. For example: At AC 0 [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BRADELINES_WELL]Bradeline's Well[\LINK] will curse the tile it's on. By AC 20, it will spread to several tiles surrounding it (range depending on mapsize, as with all Hell terrain effects). At any point up to this, if [LINK=SPELL_SANCTIFY]Sanctify[\LINK] is used to purify the *tile* of the well, all tiles it is directly cursing will begin to slowly restore. However, once the AC hits a certain threshold, the level of corruption becomes self-sustaining, and every tile cursed by Bradeline's Well will need to be sanctified, not just the origin itself!.

TEXT.English: Heroes
TEXT.French: Héros

TEXT.English: [H1]Heroes[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Heroes are unique characters that can only appear once per game. If they are killed, they can not be rebuilt. They can be gained through a variety of means, some with certain religions, some only to certain civilizations, and some are only available to the first civilization that achieves the required tech and builds them.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]They tend to be more powerful than normal units and most have the Hero promotion, which grants them 1 experience point per turn until they reach 100 xp, allowing them to level quickly and without the risk of combat.
TEXT.French: [TAB]Les Héros sont des personnages uniques qui n'apparaissent qu'une seule fois dans la partie. S'ils sont tués, ils ne peuvent être reconstruits. Ils peuvent être acquis par toute une variété de moyens, certains étant disponibles avec certaines religions, d'autres étant disponibles pour certaines civilisations, et d'autres encore sont accessibles à la première civilisation ayant terminé la technologie requise et les ayant construits.[PARAGRAPH:1]Ils tendent à être plus puissant que les unités normales et la plupart ont la promotion Héros, qui leur garanti 1 point d'expérience par tour jusqu'à ce qu'ils atteignent 100 XP, leur permettant ainsi de gagner rapidement en niveau sans se risquer au combat.
TEXT.German: [H1]Helden[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Helden sind einzigartige Charaktere im Spiel. Kommen sie um, bleiben sie unwiderbringlich. Sie sind auf verschiedenen Wegen zugänglich. Einige kommen durch bestimmte Religionen, einige sind einzelnen Zivilisationen vorbehalten, und andere können nur von der Zivilisation berufen werden, welche als Erste die erforderliche Technologie erforscht, und das zur Ausbildung benötigte Bauwerk errichtet hat.[PARAGRAPH:1]Oftmals stärker als normale Einheiten, besitzen sie zudem die Heldengabe, welche ihnen pro Runde einen Erfahrungspunkt gibt. So ist es möglich, Helden auch ohne Kampferfahrung zu befördern.
TEXT.Italian: [H1]Heroes[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Heroes are unique characters that can only appear once per game. If they are killed, they can not be rebuilt. They can be gained through a variety of means, some with certain religions, some only to certain civilizations, and some are only available to the first civilization that achieves the required tech and builds them.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]They tend to be more powerful than normal units and most have the Hero promotion, which grants them 1 experience point per turn until they reach 100 xp, allowing them to level quickly and without the risk of combat.
TEXT.Spanish: [H1]Héroes[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Los héroes son personajes únicos que sólo pueden aparecer una vez en la partida. Si son asesinados, no pueden volverse a entrenar. Se obtienen de toda clase de formas; algunos se hacen disponibles con ciertas religiones, otros están disponibles sólo para ciertas civilizaciones, y otros están disponibles para la primera civilización que alcanza una cierta tecnología y los construye.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Tienden a ser más poderosos que las unidades normales y la mayoría tienen el ascenso Héroe, que les da +1 de xp cada turno hasta alcanzar 100 xp, permitiéndoles subir rápidamente de niveles y sin el riesgo del combate.

TEXT.English: Lairs
TEXT.French: Antres

TEXT.English: [H1]Lairs[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Lairs are randomly distributed when a map is created. They spawn barbarian creatures until they are destroyed. Lairs can only be destroyed by exploring them, which may provide positive or negative results.
TEXT.French: [H1]Lairs[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Lairs are randomly distributed when a map is created. They spawn barbarian creatures until they are destroyed. Lairs can only be destroyed by exploring them, which may provide positive or negative results.
TEXT.German: [H1]Behausungen[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Behausungen werden zufällig beim generieren der Karte erzeugt. Sie erzeugen barbarische Kreaturen bis sie zerstört werden. Behausungen können nur zerstört werden indem man sie erforscht, dann entstehen positive oder negative Ergebnisse.
TEXT.Italian: [H1]Lairs[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Lairs are randomly distributed when a map is created. They spawn barbarian creatures until they are destroyed. Lairs can only be destroyed by exploring them, which may provide positive or negative results.
TEXT.Spanish: [H1]Lairs[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Lairs are randomly distributed when a map is created. They spawn barbarian creatures until they are destroyed. Lairs can only be destroyed by exploring them, which may provide positive or negative results.

TEXT.English: Mana
TEXT.French: Mana

TEXT.English: [H1]Mana[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Each civilization starts with 2-3 mana types provided by its palace. The mana you have access to controls what spells your adepts can learn. For example the Svartalfar start with Shadow, Nature and Mind mana. So their adepts can only learn spells from those spheres. To learn spells of other spheres the player will have to do one of the following to get access to those mana types:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1.[TAB]Some Wonders grant mana[NEWLINE]2.[TAB]Some Unique Features grant mana[NEWLINE]3.[TAB]You can trade mana from other players through diplomacy[NEWLINE]4.[TAB]The most common method to get access to more mana types is to upgrade raw mana nodes to the mana types you want. You need to use adepts to do this and you need the required technology. So to upgrade a raw mana node to a Death mana node (which would give you access to Death mana) you would need to have researched necromancy.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Although only 1 source of mana is required to learn the spells of that sphere if you have 2 sources of mana type your adepts start with rank 1 in that spell sphere for free. If you have 3 sources of that mana type your adepts start with rank 1 and rank 2 in that spell sphere for free.
TEXT.French: [H1]Mana[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Chaquecivilisation commence avec 2 ou 3 type de mana fournis par son palais . La Mana à laquelle vous avez accès impose les sorts que vos adeptes peuvent apprendre. par exemple les Svartalfar commencent avec les manas d'Ombre , de Nature et de Pensée. Leurs adeptes ne peuvent donc apprendre que les sorts de ces sphères . Pour pouvoir apprendre d'autres sorts, le joueur devra effectuer l'une de ces actions pour obtenir la mana voulue:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1.[TAB]Certaines merveilles fournissent de la mana[NEWLINE]2.[TAB]Certains aménagements uniques fournissent de la mana[NEWLINE]3.[TAB]Vous pouvez échanger de la mana avec d'autres joueurs grace à la diplomatie[NEWLINE]4.[TAB]La méthode la plus communs pour accéder à plus de type de mana est de transformer les nœuds de mana brute en ceux du type que vous désirez .Vous aurez besoin d'adeptes et de la technologie requise. Pour améliorer un nœud de mana brute en un nœud de mana de Mort , (qui vous donnera accès à la mana de Mort), vous devrez rechercher la technologie nécromancie .[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Bien qu'une seule source de mana soit requise pour apprendre les sorts de cette sphère, si vous avez 2 sources d'un type de mana , vos adeptes commenceront avec les sorts de niveau un de cette sphère gratuitement et si vous avez trois sources, ils commenceront avec les sorts de niveau 1 et 2 gratuitement.
TEXT.German: [H1]Mana[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Jede Zivilisation startet mit 2-3 verschiedenen Arten von Mana abhängig von ihrem Palast. Das Mana, welches man kontrolliert, bestimmt die Zauber die von Magieeinheiten erlernt werden können. Die Svartalfar zum Beispiel beginnen mit Mana der Schatten, der Natur und des Geistes. Ihre Adepten können daher nur Sprüche dieser Sphären erlernen. Um Sprüche aus anderen Sphären zu erlernen muss der Spieler eine der folgenden Möglichkeiten nutzen um Zugang zu anderen Arten von Mana zu erhalten:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1.[TAB]Einige Wunder stellen Mana zu Verfügung[NEWLINE]2.[TAB]Einige einzigartige Modernisierungen ermöglichen den Zugang zu Mana[NEWLINE]3.[TAB]Man kann Mana von anderen Spielern auf diplomatischem Weg handeln[NEWLINE]4.[TAB]Die häufigste Methode um Zugang zu einer neuen Art von Mana zu erhalten ist die Errichtung des dementsprechenden Manabrunnens auf einer unbearbeiteten Manaquelle. Um Manabrunnen zu errichten benötigt man Adepten und die jeweilige Technologie. Um also eine unbearbeitete Manaquelle zu einer Manaquelle des Todes auszubauen (welche dem Spieler Zugang zur Mana des Todes ermöglicht) muss man die Technologie Lehre der Nekromantie entdeckt haben.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Man benötigt eine Manaquelle um Sprüche der jeweiligen Sphäre zu erlernen. Besitzt man 2 Manaquellen einer Sphäre erhält der Adept den jeweiligen Zauber auf Stufe 1 umsonst. Besitzt man 3 Manaquellen einer Sphäre startet der Adept sogar mit Stufe 1 und Stufe 2 des jeweiligen Zaubers.
TEXT.Italian: [H1]Mana[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Each civilization starts with 2-3 mana types provided by its palace. The mana you have access to controls what spells your adepts can learn. For example the Svartalfar start with Shadow, Nature and Mind mana. So their adepts can only learn spells from those spheres. To learn spells of other spheres the player will have to do one of the following to get access to those mana types:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1.[TAB]Some Wonders grant mana[NEWLINE]2.[TAB]Some Unique Features grant mana[NEWLINE]3.[TAB]You can trade mana from other players through diplomacy[NEWLINE]4.[TAB]The most common method to get access to more mana types is to upgrade raw mana nodes to the mana types you want. You need to use adepts to do this and you need the required technology. So to upgrade a raw mana node to a Death mana node (which would give you access to Death mana) you would need to have researched necromancy.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Although only 1 source of mana is required to learn the spells of that sphere if you have 2 sources of mana type your adepts start with rank 1 in that spell sphere for free. If you have 3 sources of that mana type your adepts start with rank 1 and rank 2 in that spell sphere for free.
TEXT.Spanish: [H1]Maná[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Cada civilización empieza con 2-3 tipos de maná provistos por su palacio. El maná al que se tenga acceso determinará qué conjuros pueden aprender los adeptos. Por ejemplo, Svartalfar empieza con maná de Sombra, Naturaleza y Mente. Así que sus adeptos sólo pueden aprender conjuros de esas esferas. Para aprender conjuros de otras esferas el jugador tendrá que hacer una de las siguientes cosas para acceder a esos tipos de maná:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1.[TAB]Algunas maravillas proporcionan maná[NEWLINE]2.[TAB]Algunos Lugares Únicas dan maná[NEWLINE]3.[TAB]Se puede comerciar maná con otros jugadores mediante la diplomacia[NEWLINE]4.[TAB]El método más común para acceder a más clases de maná es mejorar nodos de maná bruto a las clases de maná que se deseen. Se necesitan adeptos para hacerlo y se requiere la tecnología adecuada. Por ejemplo, para mejorar un nodo de maná bruto a un nodo de maná de Muerte (que daría acceso a maná de Muerte) se necesita tener investigada la Nigromancia.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Aunque 1 fuente de maná es la requerida para aprender conjuros de una esfera, si se tiene 2 fuentes de maná del mismo tipo, los adeptos empezarán con rango 1 de conjuración de esa esfera gratis. Si se tiene 3 fuentes de maná del mismo tipo, los adeptos empezarán con rango 1 y 2 de conjuro de esa esfera gratis.

TEXT.English: Naval Crews
TEXT.French: Equipages

TEXT.English: [H1]Naval Crews[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Naval units can choose one of four possible ways to crew their ships.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1.[TAB]Normal Crew- The ship retains its normal stats.[NEWLINE]2.[TAB]Skeleton Crew- The ship gains +1 cargo capacity and -1 strength.[NEWLINE]3.[TAB]Buccaneers- The ship gains -1 movement and +1 strength.[NEWLINE]4.[TAB]Longshoremen- The ship gains +1 movement and -1 cargo capacity.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Crews on ships can be changed in any city or Pirate Cove.
TEXT.French: [H1]Equpages[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Les unités navales peuvent choisir l'un des quatres équipages suivant :[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1.[TAB]Equipage normal- Le vaisseau garde ses statistiques classiques.[NEWLINE]2.[TAB]Equipage Squelettique- Le vaisseau obtient +1 en capacité de chargement et -1 en force.[NEWLINE]3.[TAB]Flibustiers- Le vaisseau obtient -1 en mouvement et +1 en force.[NEWLINE]4.[TAB]Dockers- Le vaisseau obtient +1 en mouvement et -1 en capacité de chargement.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Les équipages peuvent être changés dans une ville ou une Crique Pirate.
TEXT.German: [H1]See-Mannschaften[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]See-Einheiten können mit vier verschiedenen Besatzungstypen ausgestattet werden.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1.[TAB]Normale Besatzung - Das Schiff behält seine normalen Werte[NEWLINE]2.[TAB]Skelettbesatzung - Das Schiff bekommt einen Bonus von 1 auf den Frachtraum und einen Malus von 1 auf die Stärke[NEWLINE]3.[TAB]Piratenbesatzung - Das Schiff bekommt einen Bonus von 1 auf die Fortbewegungsrate und einen Malus von 1 auf die Stärke,[NEWLINE]4.[TAB]Ruderbesatzung - Das Schiff bekommt einen Bonus 1 auf die Fortbewegungsrate und einen Malus von 1 auf die Frachtraumgrösse.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Die Schiffsbesatzung kann in jeder Stadt oder Piratenbucht ausgewechselt werden.
TEXT.Italian: [H1]Naval Crews[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Naval units can choose one of four possible ways to crew their ships.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1.[TAB]Normal Crew- The ship retains its normal stats.[NEWLINE]2.[TAB]Skeleton Crew- The ship gains +1 cargo capacity and -1 strength.[NEWLINE]3.[TAB]Buccaneers- The ship gains -1 movement and +1 strength.[NEWLINE]4.[TAB]Longshoremen- The ship gains +1 movement and -1 cargo capacity.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Crews on ships can be changed in any city or Pirate Cove.
TEXT.Spanish: [H1]Tripulación Naval[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Las unidades Navales pueden elegir una de cuatro posibles maneras en que la tripulación actuará en los barcos.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1.[TAB]Tripulación Normal: El barco mantiene sus estadísticas normales.[NEWLINE]2.[TAB]Tripulación Esquelética: El barco gana +1 de capacidad de carga y -1 de fuerza.[NEWLINE]3.[TAB]Bucaneros: El barco pierde -1 de movimiento a cambio de +1 de fuerza.[NEWLINE]4.[TAB]Estibadores: El barco gana +1 de movimiento y pierde -1 de capacidad de carga.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]La tripulación de una nave puede cambiarse en cualquier ciudad portuaria o en un Cala Pirata.

TEXT.English: Overcouncil
TEXT.French: Conseil Supérieur

TEXT.English: [H1]Overcouncil[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Any good or neutral player that has researched [LINK=TECH_WAY_OF_THE_WISE]Way of the Wise[\LINK] can join the Overcouncil. The primary advantage of the Overcouncil is the large diplomatic bonus with other members, but also has some special resolutions to increase trade, etc. However, it also forces members to comply with any degrees that the Overcouncil has voted and agreed on (unless the player wants to defy and leave the Overcouncil). These degrees can enforce a defensive pact between all the members, force war or stop trade with another player, outlaw death, entropy or shadow mana, and similar. Overall these laws are powerful and restrictive. Players that expect to remain members of the Overcouncil should expect to enjoy the advantages of the friendships it allows, but also be subject to its control. That is unless they maintain the relationships required to be voted the head of the council and get to pick the decrees themselves.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Empyrean religious hero, [LINK=UNIT_CHALID]Chalid Astrakein[\LINK], and the Malakim Civilization's hero, [LINK=UNIT_TEUTORIX]Teutorix[\LINK], are both councilors, giving the civilization that controls them an additional vote in the Overcouncil.

TEXT.English: Settlements
TEXT.French: Campements

TEXT.English: [H1]Settlements[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Kuriotates can only have a few real cities (the exact number depends on the map size), all the rest of their cities are settlements. Settlements are unable to produce gold, research or culture and nothing can be built in a Settlement. They don't cost any maintenance.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Duel- 2 cities max[NEWLINE][TAB]Tiny- 2 cities max[NEWLINE][TAB]Small- 3 cities max[NEWLINE][TAB]Standard- 3 cities max[NEWLINE][TAB]Large- 4 cities max[NEWLINE][TAB]Huge- 5 cities max[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notes: Originally we designed the Kuriotates to only have their limited number of huge super cities. But being unable to expand and claim more resources was to limiting for them so we created settlements as a way to still allow the Kuriotates to expand their borders without adding to the production capacity, or significantly to their population.

They don't cost any maintenance.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Duel- 2 cities max[NEWLINE][TAB]Tiny- 2 cities max[NEWLINE][TAB]Small- 3 cities max[NEWLINE][TAB]Standard- 3 cities max[NEWLINE][TAB]Large- 4 cities max[NEWLINE][TAB]Huge- 5 cities max[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notes: Originally we designed the Kuriotates to only have their limited number of huge super cities. But being unable to expand and claim more resources was to limiting for them so we created settlements as a way to still allow the Kuriotates to expand their borders without adding to the production capacity, or significantly to their population.[NEWLINE]Ce bâtiment indique un campement périphérique des Kuriotates. Il n'a pas accès aux multiples bâtiments et unités que produisent les vraies villes, il ne produit pas de recherche et ne requiert aucune maintenance. Au lieu de cela, il est utilisé pour élargir les frontières kuriotates afin que leur influence aillent au-delà des trois villes primaires.]

TEXT.English: Somnium
TEXT.French: Somnium

TEXT.English: [H1]Somnium[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Somnium allows you to pick any AI leader you have contact, and aren't at war with, and challenge them to a game of cards. If you win the game you get a positive attitude bonus with that leader, if you lose you get a negative attitude penalty.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Rules[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]There are 10 suits with 5 cards numbered 3-7 in each. The suits are Angels, Demons, Dragons, Swords, Cups, Pentagrams, Towers, Wands, Suns and Moons. There are also 3 Fool cards and 1 Death card. [PARAGRAPH:1]The player starts his turn by drawing a card. He can draw again or stop and collect all the cards he has turned up into his "bank". The player can continue drawing as long as he wants but his turn is ended and all of his turned up cards are discarded if he ever gets 2 cards of the same suit turned up at once. Play continues back and forth between players until all 54 cards in the deck have been drawn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Example of Play:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The player starts by turning over the 3 of Moons. He decides to draw again and draws the 6 of Wands. He decides to draw again and draws the 4 of Towers. He decides to draw again and draws the 4 of Wands. That last 4 is a duplicate, that is 2 cards of wands and all 4 cards he drew are lost and his turn is ended. If he would have stopped drawing after the 4 of Towers he would have been able to bank all 3 cards he drawn to that point and his turn would have been over.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Special Cards:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Fool- There are three Fool cards in the deck. They allow the player to steal a card form his opponents bank and add it to the drawn card pile. If your opponent has no cards in his bank the Fool is discarded. [PARAGRAPH:1]Death- Drawing the death card automatically ends your turn and causes you to lose all your cards. There is only one death card in the deck.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Victory:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]In the end each player gets points for the highest card in his bank he has of each suit (so if he has the 3, 4 and 5 of Moons he only counts the 5) and the player with the most points wins.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Strategy:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The game is about risk and deciding if you should go for that next card or not. There will be easy choices (obviously turning up a 3 of moons doesn't mean much if you already have the 5 of moons banked), and difficult ones (if your first card is the 7 of Suns should you risk it and try to get another, or just consider yourself lucky and end there). Each AI player has a different level of aggressiveness in the game, some will play conservatively, some will be more reckless.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Credits:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Programmer: Stéphane "Sto" Nadry[NEWLINE]Game Designer: Derek "Kael" Paxton[NEWLINE]Art: Stephanie Pui-Mun Law and Jason Engle
TEXT.French: [H1]Somnium[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Somnium vous permet de choisir n'importe quel AI leader avec lequel vous êtes en contact et en paix, et de le défier dans un jeu de cartes. Si vous gagnez la partie vous obtenez un point de bonus d'attitude avec ce leader. Et si vous perdez vous avez une pénalité d'un point d'attitude avec ce leader.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Rules[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Il y a 10 familles de 5 cartes numérotées de 3 à 7. Les familles sont les Anges, Démons, Dragons, Epées, Coupes, Pentagrammes, tours, Baguettes magiques, Soleils et Lunes. Il y a aussi 3 jokers et La Mort. [PARAGRAPH:1]Le joueur commence son tour par tirer une carte. Il peut continuer de tirer des cartes ou s'arreter et mettre toutes les cartes qu'il a retourné dans sa "Banque". Le joueur peut continuer de tirer des cartes autant qu'il veut, mais son tour se termine et les cartes sont jetées s'il retourne 2 cartes de la même famille. Le jeu se termine quand toutes les 54 cartes ont été tirées.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Exemple de partie:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Le joueur commence par tirer le 3 des Lunes. Il decide de piocher encore et tire le 6 des baguetttes magiques. Il décide de piocher encore et tire le 4 des Tours. Il décide de piocher encore et tire le 4 des Baguettes magiques. Il y a deux cartes de baguettes magiques, toutes les cartes sont donc jetées et son tour se termine. S'il s'était arréter après avoir tirer le 4 des tours, il aurait mis en banque les 3 cartes tirées et son tour se serait terminé aussi.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Cartes spéciales:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Le Joker- Il y a 3 Jokers dans le pacquet de carte. Il permet de voler une carte de la banque de l'adversaire et de la mettre dans les cartes piochées. Si votre opposant n'a pas de cartes dans sa banque, le Joker est jeté. [PARAGRAPH:1]La Mort- Tirer la carte de la mort met fin a votre tour et toutes les cartes piochées sont jetées. La Mort est une carte unique.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Victoire:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A la fin de la partie, chaque joueur reçoit des points pour la plus grosses cartes de chaque famille qu'il possède (si vous avez par exemple le 3, 4 et 6 des Lunes, seul le 6 compte) et le joueur avec le plus de points gagne.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Stratégie:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]La décision se fait quand vous choisissez de tirer la prochaine carte ou non. Il y aura des choix simples (naturellement tirer un 3 des Lunes n'apporte pas grand chose si vous avez déjà un 5 des Lunes en banque), et des choix difficiles (si votre première carte est un 7 des soleils. Allez vous prendre le risque de tirer une autre carte, ou juste considérer que c'est déjà un bon tirage). Chaque AI Leader joue de façon plus ou moins aggressive. Certains vont jouer de façon très conservatrice et d'autres de façon très brutale.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Crédits:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Programmeur: Stéphane Nadry dit "Sto"[NEWLINE]Concepteur du jeu: Derek Paxton dit "Kael"[NEWLINE]Graphismes: Stephanie Pui-Mun Law et Jason Engle
TEXT.German: [H1]Somnium[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Somnium erlaubt Euch, einen beliebigen KI-Herrscher, vorausgesetzt Ihr habt Kontakt miteinander und steht nicht mit ihm im Krieg, auszuwählen und ihn zu einer Partie Somnium herauszufordern. Wenn Ihr das Spiel gewinnt, bekommt ihr einen positiven Beziehungsbonus zu diesem Herrscher, wenn ihr verliert, einen negativen.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Regeln[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Es gibt 10 Farben mit jeweils 5 Karten, jeweils nummeriert von 3-7. Die Farben sind: Engel, Dämonen, Drachen, Schwerter, Kelche, Pentagramme, Türme, Zauberstäbe, Sonnen und Monde. Es gibt außerdem 3 Narrenkarten und 1 Todeskarte.[PARAGRAPH:1]Der Spieler beginnt seinen Zug, indem er eine Karte zieht und umdreht. Er kann erneut ziehen oder aufhören und alle Karten, die er umgedreht hat, auf seine Bank stellen. Der Spieler kann mit Ziehen fortfahren, so lange er will, aber sein Zug endet und alle seine umgedrehten Karten werden abgeworfen, sobald er zwei Karten derselben Farbe umgedreht hat. Die Spieler machen abwechselnd ihre Züge, bis alle 54 Karten umgedreht wurden.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Beispiel:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Ein Spieler startet seinen Zug und dreht die Mond-3 um. Er zieht erneut und dreht die Zauberstab-6 um. Er entscheidet sich erneut zu ziehen und erhält die Turm-4. Er zieht nochmal und dreht die Zauberstab-4 um. Die letzte 4 ist die zweite Zauberstab-Karte und alle 4 umgedrehten Karten werden abgelegt und sein Zug ist beendet. Wenn er nach der Turm-4 aufgehört hätte, hätte er alle 3 umgedrehten Karten auf seine Bank stellen können und sein Zug wäre ebenfalls vorbei gewesen.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Spezialkarten:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Der Narr - Es gibt 3 Narrenkarten im Spiel. Sie gestatten es dem Spieler, eine Karte von der Bank des Gegenspielers zu stehlen und sie zu den aufgedeckten Karten zu legen. Wenn der Gegenspieler keine Karten auf seiner Bank hat, wird der Narr einfach abgelegt.[PARAGRAPH:1]Der Tod - Den Tod zu ziehen bedeutet das Ende des Zuges und alle Karten zu verlieren. Es gibt nur eine Todeskarte im Spiel.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Siegbedingungen:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Am Ende des Spieles erhält jeder Spieler Punkte für die jeweils höchste Karte einer Farbe auf seiner Bank (d.h. wenn er die 3, 4 und 5 der Monde hat, bekommt er 5 Punkte) und der Spieler mit den meisten Punkten gewinnt.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Strategie:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Das Spiel handelt von Strategie und der Entscheidung, ob man noch eine Karte ziehen oder aufhören soll. Es gibt einfache Entscheidungen (die Mond-3 aufzudecken bedeutet offensichtlich nichts, wenn man schon die Mond-5 auf der Bank hat) und schwere (wenn die erste Karte die Sonnen-7 ist, sollte man sie dann riskieren und eine weitere ziehen, oder sich einfach als Glückspilz betrachten und aufhören?). Jeder KI-Spieler hat einen unterschiedlichen Grad von Aggressivität in dem Spiel, einige spielen konservativ, einige werden eher waghalsig sein.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Credits:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Programmer: Stéphane "Sto" Nadry[NEWLINE]Game Designer: Derek "Kael" Paxton[NEWLINE]Art: Stephanie Pui-Mun Law and Jason Engle
