TEXT.English: Spells
TEXT.French: Magie

TEXT.English: [H1]Spells[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Magic can turn the tide of battle and push even peaceful civilizations to greater glory.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Magic can be divided into divine and arcane. Divine magic-using units are Priests, which require Priesthood, and their upgrade, High Priests, which require Theology and a level 6 priest. Arcane units include Mages which must be upgraded from adepts who have attained level four, and Archmages, which require level 6 mages. Don't worry, your spellcasting units don't have to get their staves dirty, for they gain experience over time, slower than, but similar to, hero units. Spiritual and Arcane leaders increase this automatic experience rate for disciple and arcane units respectively. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]To cast a spell, an arcane unit needs a magic sphere promotion, and a "magic control" promotion called channeling, the latter coming automatically when a unit is built or upgraded. Magic sphere promotions can be given upon level gain. Divine units, on the other hand, have a limited, but quite useful, selection of spells automatically, depending on what creed they espouse (their religion). Arcane units are more versatile, being able to choose from any of the sphere upgrades on promotion if you control that mana source. Further, every mana node you control when an adept is trained will give the corresponding spell sphere promotion if you control more than one source. Since Adepts will not gain experience forever, owning multiple mana nodes will allow you to create more powerful spell casters at the cost of options.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Arcane magic is quite varied. Some spells give units exclusive promotions, others create temporary units, and some enhance terrain or cities.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A couple more important points-Unless your leader has the Summoner trait, summoned creatures last only one turn before they must return to the ether. Combat promotions given to spell casters apply to their spells, so a mage with combat 2 will have stronger fireball. Similarly, spell extension promotions allow a mage's spells an extra movement point, allow him to stay a safe distance from his targets.
TEXT.French: [H1]Spells[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]La magie peut changer l'issue d'une bataille et conduire même des civilisations pacifiques vers une grande victoire.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]La magie peut être divisée entre le divin et l'arcane. Les unités utilisant la magie divine inclus les Prêtres et les Grands Prêtres, accessible lorsque la technologie requise a été découverte. Les unités arcanes inclus les Mages, les Archimages, les Conjurateurs et les Evocateurs, tous devant être améliorés depuis les Adeptes qui ont atteint un niveau assez haut. Ne vous inquiétez pas, vos lanceurs de sorts n'ont pas à se salir les mains, ils gagnent de l'expérience avec le temps, plus lentement mais d'une manière similaire aux héros.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Pour lancer un sort, une unité a besoin de la promotion dans la sphère de magie, et une promotion de "contrôle magique", cette dernière étant automatique lorsqu'une unité est entraînée ou améliorée. Les promotions de sphère de magie peuvent être données à chaque niveau pour les unités divines et arcanes. Les unités divines ont une sélection limitée mais utile de sphères à choisir, dépendant de la croyance qu'ils ont épousé (leur religion). Les unités arcanes sont plus versatiles, pouvant être promue dans n'importe quelle sphère de magie. Chaque nœud de mana que vous contrôlez lorsqu'un adepte est créé vous permettra de lui assigner la sphère de magie correspondante (exemple: si vous possédez un Nœud de Terre, l'Adepte pourra avoir la promotion Terre I) et posséder plusieurs Nœud d'un même type donne une promotion plus élevée : 2 Nœuds de Terre donne automatiquement la promotion Terre I, 3 Nœuds donne la promotion Terre II, la promotion Terre III ne peut être acquise ainsi.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]La magie des arcanes est très variée. Expérimentez les différentes sphères de magie pour trouver tous les sorts. Quelques exemples : un adepte avec Corps I peut lancer Hâte, qui donnera à toutes les unités de la pile un point de mouvement supplémentaire pour un tour. Les Conjurateurs avec Chaos II peut évoquer un Diablotin, monstre d'une force de 3 qui vous servira et connait ses propres sorts ! Les Mages avec Feu II peuvent lancer des boules de feu pour attaquer les piles d'unités pour infliger de légers dégâts collatéraux.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Quelques points importants : à moins que votre dirigeant possède le trait Evocateur, les créatures évoquées ne dure qu'un seul tour avant de retourner dans l'éther. Les promotions de combat données aux lanceurs de sorts s'appliquent à leurs sorts, ainsi un mage du feu avec Combat II (puissance +40%) aura plus de puissance d'attaque (promotion Habilité II pour ses boules de feu, soit puissance +20% ). De même, la promotion Extension de Sorts permet aux sorts du mage d'avoir une portée d'une case supplémentaire ou un point de mouvement en plus pour les évocations, lui permettant de restait à une saine distance du danger.
TEXT.German: [H1]Zauber[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Magie hat die Macht das Blatt in der Schlacht zu wenden, und selbst friedliche Zivilisationen zu höherem Ruhm zu führen.[PARAGRAPH:1]Magie kann in göttliche und weltliche Magie geteilt werden. Einheiten die göttliche Magie verwenden sind unter anderem Priester und Hohepriester, welche beide für sich allein erstellt werden können, vorausgesetzt, die entsprechende Technologie wurde entdeckt. magisch begabte Einheiten sind unter anderem Magier, Erzmagier, Beschwörer, und Rufer, die alle aus Adepten aufgewertet werden müssen, sobald die Adepten die geforderte Stufe erreicht haben. Beunruhigen Sie sich nicht, Ihre zaubernden Einheiten müssen sich nicht die Hände schmutzig machen, da sie mit der Zeit von selbst Erfahrung sammeln, zwar langsamer aber sonst genauso wie Helden.[PARAGRAPH:1]Um einen Zauber zu sprechen, benötigt die Einheit eine Spruchkategorie-Beförderung und eine "Magische Kontrolle" Beförderung, letztere bekommen sie automatisch wenn sie errichtet oder aufgewertet werden. Spruchkategorie-Beförderungen können je nach Stufe verliehen werden, und zwar sowohl göttliche als auch weltliche. Göttliche Einheiten haben eine beschränkte, wenn auch recht nützliche Auswahl von Sphären, abhängig von ihrer Religion. magische begabte Einheiten sind vielseitiger, und können bei jeder Beförderung aus allen Sphärenaufwertungen wählen. Weiterhin ermöglicht jede Mana-Quelle, die Sie kontrollieren wenn der Adept ausgebildet wird, die entsprechende Sphären Beförderung. Da Adepten nicht für immer Erfahrung sammeln werden, wird Ihnen der Besitz von Mana-Quellen erlauben, viel stärkere Zauberer zu erschaffen.[PARAGRAPH:1]Weltliche Magie ist ziemlich weit gestreut. Experimentieren Sie mit verschiedenen Spruchkategorien um alle Zauber zu finden. Einige Beispiele: Adepten mit Körper 1 können Schnelligkeit zaubern, was allen Einheiten auf ihrem Feld für eine Runde einen zusätzlichen Bewegungspunkt gibt. Beschwörer mit Chaos 2 können Imp Herbeirufen zaubern, was ein Stärke-3 Monster beschwört um Ihnen zu dienen-eines, das sogar selbst zaubern kann! Magier mit Feuer 2 können Feuerball beschwören, welcher dann Einheitenstapel angreifen kann um einen kleineren Kollateralschaden zu verursachen.[PARAGRAPH:1]Noch ein paar wichtigere Punkte: Außer wenn Ihr Anführer die Fähigkeit Beschwörer hat, bleiben beschworene Kreaturen nur eine Runde lang bevor sie in den Äther zurückkehren müssen. Kampfbeförderungen die Zauberern erteilt werden, wirken auf deren Zauber, so dass ein Feuermagier mit Kampf 2 mehr Feuerkraft hat. Nach dem gleichen Schema erlauben Zauberausdehnungsbeförderungen den Zaubern des Magiers einen zusätzlichen Bewegungspunkt, und ermöglichen ihm so, in einer sicheren Distanz zu der Gefahr zu stehen.

Similarly, spell extension promotions allow a mage's spells an extra movement point, allow him to stay a safe distance from his targets.
TEXT.Spanish: [H1]Conjuros[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]La magia puede cambiar las tornas de una batalla e incluso empujar a civilizaciones pacíficas a una mayor gloria.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]La magia puede ser dividida en divina y arcana. Entre las unidades usuarias de magia divina destacan los Sacerdotes y los Altos Sacerdotes, cada uno de los cuales puede ser construido independientemente, provistos de la tecnología apropiada que haya sido descubierta. Las unidades arcanas incluyen Magos, Archimagos, Conjuradores, e Invocadores, cada uno de los cuales debe ser ascendido desde un adepto que haya conseguido suficiente nivel de experiencia. Las unidades lanzadoras de hechizos ganan experiencia con el tiempo, más lentamente que los héroes pero igual que ellos.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Para lanzar un conjuro, una unidad necesita el escenso de una esfera de magia, y un ascenso de "control de la magia"; ésta última viene automáticamente cuando la unidad es construida o mejorada. Los ascensos de esferas de magia pueden ser dados en cada subida de nivel tanto de clase divina como arcana. Las unidades divinas tienen un abanico limitado, pero bastante útil, de elección de esferas, dependiendo del credo que prediquen (su religión). Las unidades Arcanas con más versátiles, siendo capaces de elegir entre cualquier ascenso o mejora de cualquier esfera. Además, dependiendo de cada nodo de maná que se controle, cuando un adepto es entrenado, se les dará el ascenso de la esfera correspondiente. Como los adeptos no ganarán experiencia por siempre, controlar nodos de maná parmitirá crear lanzadores de hechizos mucho más poderosos.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]La magia arcana es muy variada. Hay que experimentar con diferentes esferas de conjuros hasta encontrar todos los conjuros. Ejemplos: los adeptos con Cuerpo 1 pueden lanzar Prisa, que dará a todas las unidades en la misma casilla un punto extra de movimiento durante un turno. Los conjuradores con Caos 2 pueden lanzar Convocar Imp, que convoca a un monstruo de fuerza 3 para servirle... ¡uno que podría conocer conjuros suyos! Los magos con Fuego 2 pueden lanzar Bola de Fuego, que puede atacar a pilas de unidades para inflijir daños colaterales menores.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Un par de puntos importantes más... A menos que el líder de la civilización tenga el rasgo Convocador, las criaturas convocadas duran sólo un turno antes de que deban volver al éter. Los ascensos de combate dados a los lanzadores de hechizos se aplican a sus conjuros, así que un mago de fuego con Combate 2 tendrá más potencia de fuego. De forma similar, los ascensos de extensión de conjuros da a los conjuros del mago un punto extra de movimiento, permitiéndole permancer a una distancia segura del peligro.

TEXT.English: Undercouncil
TEXT.French: Conseil Souterrain

TEXT.English: [H1]Undercouncil[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Undercouncil serves a similar purpose to the Overcouncil. Available with the [LINK=TECH_WAY_OF_THE_WICKED]Way of the Wicked[\LINK] technology, it can only be joined by Neutral or Evil players, and although they don't have to worship the Council of Esus religion to join, they can't also be members of the Overcouncil.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Undercouncil is run by money, and nearly all of its resolutions cost gold from its members. Like the Overcouncil, they can vote to declare war on a common enemy or open borders to each other, but unlike the Overcouncil there are no restrictive resolutions on the Undercouncil; they never vote to enforce a civic or outlaw anything. Also unlike the Overcouncil, they can pass more varied and unique resolutions, and most resolutions increase the crime rate slightly. The Undercouncil's special resolutions and costs are:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Enlist the Nightwatch - 25 Gold - All players gain a Nightwatch with no support cost.[NEWLINE][TAB]Develop Secret Codes - 25 Gold - Technologies can only be traded with other Undercouncil members, but each member earns a free Great Sage.[NEWLINE][TAB]Fund Dissidents - 50 Gold - Temporarily increases unhappiness in Overcouncil civs.[NEWLINE][TAB]Gambling Ring - 25 Gold - Reduces the production cost of gambling houses in all your cities by 75 percent.[NEWLINE][TAB]Slave Trade - 25 Gold - All Undercouncil members can buy and sell slaves.[NEWLINE][TAB]Smuggling Ring - 25 Gold - Allows coastal cities to build a [LINK=BUILDING_SMUGGLERS_PORT]Smuggler's Port[\LINK], and increases trade routes by 1.

TEXT.English: [H1]Unique Features[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Unique Features are randomly generated when the map is created. There can only be one of each on each map and the chance that each will appear is based on the map size. The potential Unique Features are:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_AIFON_ISLE]Aifon Isle[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BAIR_OF_LACUNA]Bair of Lacuna[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BRADELINES_WELL]Bradeline's Well[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BROKEN_SEPULCHER]Broken Sepulcher[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CLIFFS_OF_TALI]Cliffs of Kelle[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_DRAGON_BONES]Dragon Bones[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_FOXFORD]Foxford[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_GUARDIAN]Guardian of Pristin Pass[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_LETUM_FRIGUS]Letum Frigus[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MAELSTROM]Maelstrom[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MIRROR_OF_HEAVEN]Mirror of Heaven[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MOUNT_KALSHEKK]Mount Kalshekk[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_ODIOS_PRISON]Odio's Prison[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_POOL_OF_TEARS]Pool of Tears[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_PYRE_OF_THE_SERAPHIC]Pyre of the Seraphic[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_REMNANTS_OF_PATRIA]Remnants of Patria[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_RING_OF_CARCER]Ring of Carcer[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_RINWELL]Rinwell Isle[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_SEVEN_PINES]Seven Pines[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_SIRONAS_BEACON]Sirona's Beacon[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_STANDING_STONES]Standing Stones[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_TOMB_OF_SUCELLUS]Tomb of Sucellus[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_TOWER_OF_EYES]Tower of Eyes[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_YGGDRASIL]Yggdrasil[\LINK][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notes: Unique Features were added to make each map more interesting. Plus some of the wonders we have had in the mod since the beginning (like Yggdrasil and the Tomb of Sucellus) never really made much sense as buildable wonders, better to be things the player would find.

Es kann jeweils nur eine Einzige von jeder Art auf der Karte geben, wobei die Wahrscheinlichkeit des Auftretens durch die Kartengröße bestimmt wird. Die möglichen Einzigartigen Modernisierungen sind:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_AIFON_ISLE]Insel der Aifon[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BRADELINES_WELL]Bradelines Brunnen[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BROKEN_SEPULCHER]Geöffnetes Grab[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_DRAGON_BONES]Drachenknochen[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_GUARDIAN]Wächter des Pristinpasses[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_LETUM_FRIGUS]Letum Frigus[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MAELSTROM]Mahlstrom[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MIRROR_OF_HEAVEN]Himmelsspiegel[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_ODIOS_PRISON]Odios Gefängnis[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_POOL_OF_TEARS]See der Tränen[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_PYRE_OF_THE_SERAPHIC]Scheiterhaufen der Engel[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_REMNANTS_OF_PATRIA]Überreste von Patria[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_SEVEN_PINES]Sieben Kiefern[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_TOMB_OF_SUCELLUS]Grab des Sucellus[\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_YGGDRASIL]Weltenbaum Yggdrasil[\LINK][NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Anmerkung von Kael[COLOR_REVERT]: Einzigartige Modernisierungen wurden eingeführt, um die Karten interessanter zu gestalten. Außerdem waren einige der geplanten Wunder nicht dafür geeignet, vom Spieler errichtet zu werden (wie der Weltenbaum Yggdrasil und das Grab des Sucellus). Daher ist es sinnvoller, wenn sie vom Spieler gefunden werden können.

TEXT.English: Victory - Tower of Mastery
TEXT.French: Victoire - Tour de Maîtrise

TEXT.English: [H1]Victory - Tower of Mastery[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]This victory condition requires that the player first build the four lesser towers; the Tower of Alteration, Tower of Divination, Tower of Necromancy and the Tower of the Elements. Each of these towers require multiple mana types to be built and all the games mana types must be controlled to build all of them. Once they are all built the player can begin building the Tower of Master. If that is completed the player wins the game.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notes- This victory condition is a homage to the amazing Master of Magic game. When it was initially added it was nearly impossible to achieve without practically winning a domination victory first, and even then it was only possible on the largest map sizes. The plan was always to introduce more ways to get the mana required to create the lesser towers rather than to make the victory condition easier and with the introduction of Vassals (or more importantly the access that gives to their palace mana) we achieved that goal. Making this a reasonable victory condition that can be achieved through expansion, conquest or diplomacy (or, most effectively, a combination of the three).
TEXT.French: [H1]Victoire - Tour de Maîtrise[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Cette condition de victoire impose d'abord au joueur de construire les quatre tours mineures; la Tour d'Altération, la Tour de Divination, ve Nécromancie et la Tour des Eléments. Chacune d'entre elles a besoin de plusieurs types de mana pour être construites et tous les types de mana du jeu doivent être controlés pour pouvoir toutes les construire. Un fois qu'elles sont toutes contruites le joueur peut alors construire la Tour de Maîtrise. Si celle ci est terminée le joueur gagne la partie.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Note de Kael- Cette condition de victoire est un hommage au fameux jeu Master of Magic. Lorsqu'elle a d'abord été ajoutée, il était presque impossible de la construire sans obtenir d'abord une victoire par domination , et encore seulement sur les plus grandes cartes . Le but a toujours été d'ajouter des méthodes pour obtenir les divers types de mana requis pour la construction des tours plutôt que de faciliter la condition de victoire et avec l'introduction des Vassaux( ou plus important à l'accès qu'ils offrent au mana de leur palais), nous avons atteint ce but. C'est une condition de victoire raisonnable qui peut être atteinte à la fois par l'expansion, la conquête ou la diplomatie.
TEXT.German: [H1]Siegvariante - Turm der Macht[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Diese Siegbedingung erfordert das Errichten der vier niederen Türme: Turm der Alteration, Turm der Weissagung, Turm der Nekromantie und Turm der Elemente. Jeder dieser Türme erfordert verschiedene Arten von Mana und um alle vier zu bauen benötigt man die Kontrolle über alle Typen von Mana. Wurden alle vier Türme errichtet kann der Spieler mit dem Bau an dem Turm der Macht beginnen. Ist der Bau vollendet gewinnt der Spieler das Spiel.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notiz: Diese Sigbedingung ist eine Anlehnung an das fantastische Spiel Master of Magic. Zu Beginn war es praktisch unmöglich den Turm der Macht zu errichten ohne vorher einen Sieg der Domination zu erlangen und selbst dann war es nur auf den grössten Karten möglich. Es war der Plan mehrere Wege zu ermöglichen an die gesamten Arten von Mana zu kommen, um die vier niederen Türme zu bauen, ohne die Siegbedingungen zu vereinfachen. Dies gelingt mit der Einführung der Vasallen (insbesondere durch Zugang ihrer Mana, die sie durch ihren Palast erhalten). Dies macht die Siegbedingung des Turmes der Macht zu einer Siegvariante, die durch Expansion, Eroberung und Diplomatie (oder einer Kombination mehrerer) erreicht werden kann.

Each of these towers require multiple mana types to be built and all the games mana types must be controlled to build all of them. Once they are all built the player can begin building the Tower of Master. If that is completed the player wins the game.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notes- This victory condition is a homage to the amazing Master of Magic game. When it was initially added it was nearly impossible to achieve without practically winning a domination victory first, and even then it was only possible on the largest map sizes. The plan was always to introduce more ways to get the mana required to create the lesser towers rather than to make the victory condition easier and with the introduction of Vassals (or more importantly the access that gives to their palace mana) we achieved that goal. Making this a reasonable victory condition that can be achieved through expansion, conquest or diplomacy (or, most effectively, a combination of the three).
TEXT.Spanish: [H1]Victoria - Torre de la Maestría[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Esta condición de victoria requiere que el jugador construya primero las cuatro torres menores; la Torre de Alteración, la Torre de la Adivinación, la Torre de la Nigromancia y la Torre de los Elementos. Cada una de estas torres requieren múltiples tipos de maná para ser construidas y todos los tipos de maná del juego son los que hay que controlar para construir todas ellas. Una vez construidas el jugador puede empezar a construir la Torre de la Maestría. Si es completada, el jugador gana el juego.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Notas de Kael: Esta condición de victoria está basada en el juego Master of Magic. Inicialmente, cuando la añadimos era prácticamente imposible de conseguir sin ganar primero por dominación, e incluso entonces sólo era posible en los mapas de tamaño más grande. El plan siempre fue introducir más formas de conseguir el maná requerido para crear las torres menores en lugar de hacer la condición de victoria más fácil y con la introducción de los Vasales (o más importante el acceso que da su palacio de maná) logramos ese objetivo. Haciendola como una condición de victoria razonable que puede alcanzarse sin la expansión, la conquista o la diplomacia (o, más correctamente, una combinación de las tres).

TEXT.English: Weapon Upgrades
TEXT.French: Améliorations des Armes

TEXT.English: [H1]Weapon Upgrades[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Some units can have their strength upgraded by certain weapon types. Units capable of using [LINK=PROMOTION_BRONZE_WEAPONS]Bronze weapons[\LINK] get +1 strength if you have access to [LINK=BONUS_COPPER]copper[\LINK]. Units capable of using [LINK=PROMOTION_IRON_WEAPONS]Iron weapons[\LINK] get +2 strength if you have access to [LINK=BONUS_IRON]iron[\LINK] and units capable of using [LINK=PROMOTION_MITHRIL_WEAPONS]Mithril weapons[\LINK] get +4 strength if you have access to [LINK=BONUS_MITHRIL]mithril[\LINK]. Multiple weapon types aren't cumulative (a unit can't have both iron and mithril weapons) and units have to enter one of your cities to upgrade their weapons.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Note that getting access to copper requires the [LINK=TECH_BRONZE_WORKING]Bronze Working[\LINK] tech (even though it is revealed with Mining). Getting access to Iron requires the [LINK=TECH_IRON_WORKING]Iron Working[\LINK] tech (though it is revealed with Smelting) and getting access to Mithril requires the [LINK=TECH_MITHRIL_WORKING]Mithril Working[\LINK] tech.

TEXT.English: Werewolves
TEXT.French: Loup-Garous

TEXT.English: [H1]Werewolves[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Werewolves of Erebus have slipped into legend since the death of Baron Duin Halfmorn, but rumors also mention a small village in which they may still clutch to existence. Should these rumors prove true, or the Baron be brought back from the grave, they may sweep across the land once more.[PARAGRAPH:1]Werewolves can be found in wild lairs on occasion, locked in their natural form and as mindless as any other animal, but units killed by a Werewolf have a chance of being reborn under the control of their former enemy and infected with the curse of the Wolf. The unit will initially be weakened and suffer from an insatiable lust for violence. This may lead to occasional periods of rebellion, and continues until the Wolfling has regained their former strength. After that the unit is typically able to contain the wilder impulses, and begins to grow more powerful through the effects of the curse.

TEXT.English: -- What is Fall from Heaven? --
TEXT.French: -- Qu'est ce que Fall From Heaven? --

TEXT.English: [H1]What is Fall from Heaven?[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Based on a long running Dungeons and Dragons campaign Fall from Heaven is set in the dark fantasy world of Erebus. This is a world where the themes of corruption and redemption are repeated and all the characters, including the gods themselves, are imperfect.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Although the mod isn't a direct translation of any of the following inspiration comes from Celtic and Norse mythology, Judeo-Christian mysticism and the works of Edgar Allen Poe and H.P. Lovecraft.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notes: The goal of this mod is to provide a turn based strategy game with a focus on replayability. I am a huge fan of the Civilization series but after playing a dozen or so games they began to feel the same. That's actually a pretty amazing feat, what other game can you beat a dozen times before it starts to feel the same?[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]We pursued our replayability goal by making a few key decisions:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1.[TAB]Each civilization should be fundamentally different than any other. Much more than just a different Unique Unit and Unique Building we want the player to have to adapt to different strategies and play styles to play each civ. We understood that not all players would like all civs, but each would find some that appealed to their play style and players in for a new experience could try something that played differently than they were used to.[NEWLINE]2.[TAB]A players state religion should have a dramatic effect on his civilization. As such there are really 7 versions of each civilization, that civilization with each religion.[NEWLINE]3.[TAB]A general dislike for patterns. Although easy to design and balance patterns are generally uncreative. Instead we craft each option individually and try to balance overall rather than on the specific option being created.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Overall this means that FfH has a higher learning curve than most games, all of these options come at a cost. But once learned our hope is that there is game deep enough for players to enjoy for months or years.
TEXT.French: [H1]Qu'est ce que Fall From Heaven?[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Basé sur une longue campagne de Donjons et Dragons, Fall from Heaven Dans le monde de Dark-Fantasy d'Erebus. C'est un monde dans lequel les thèmes de corruption et de rédemption sont omniprésents et où tous , même les dieux, sont imparfaits.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Bien que le mod ne soit pas directement une adaptation des mythes suivants, l'inspiration vient de la mythologie nordique et celtique , du mysticisme judéo-chrétien et de l'œuvre d'Edgar Allen Poe et de H.P. Lovecraft.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Note de Kael: Le but de ce mod est de fournir un jeu de stratégie tour par tour basée sur le plasir de rejouer. Je suis un grand fan des Civilization mais au bout d'une douzaine de parties, elles commencent à toutes se ressembler. C'est déjà très surprenant, quel autre jeu pouvez-vous finir une douzaine de fois avant de seulement commencer à avoir l'impression que tout commence à se ressembler[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Nous avons poursuivi dans cette voie en prenant quelques décisions clés :[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1.[TAB]Chaque civilisation est fondamentalement différente des autres. Bien plus qu'une unité et un batiment unique, nous voulons que le joueur ait à s'adapter à différentes stratégies et styles de jeu pour jouer chaque civ. Nous comprenons que tous les joueurs n'aimeraient pas toutes les civs, mais que chacun trouve celle qui corresponde à leur style ou que les joueurs en quète de nouvelles expériences en essayent une différente de ce dont ils ont l'habitude.[NEWLINE]2.[TAB]La religion d'état d'un joueur a un effet drastique sur sa civilisation.En fait il y a 7 manière de jouer une civilisation, une pour chaque religion.[NEWLINE]3.[TAB]Un refus général des options semblables. Biens qu' faciles à designer et à équilibrer , celles-ci sont généralement peu créatives. En fait nous créeons une option particulière et originale et tentons d'équilibrer l'ensemble plutôt que l'option nouvellement créer.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Dans l'ensemble , cela implique que Fall From Heaven nécessite plus de temps pour être complètement pris en main par le joueur, mais nous pensons qu'une fois cela fait , il s'agit d'un jeu assez profond pour que les jouerus y passent des mois ou des années.
TEXT.German: [H1]Was ist Fall from Heaven?[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Basierend auf einer langen Kampagne von Dungeons and Dragons, Fall from Heaven spielt in der dunklen Fantasywelt Erebus. Es ist eine Welt, in der Korruption und Erlösung sich abwechseln und alle Charaktere, inklusive der Guten, unvollkommen sind.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Obwohl diese Mod keine direkte Umsetzung der folgenden Einflüsse darstellt, stellen sie doch eine wichtige Inspirationsquelle dar. Zur Inspiration dienen die keltische und nordische Mythologie, der jüdisch-christliche Mystizismus sowie die Arbeiten von Edgar Allen Poe und Howard Phillips Lovecraft.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Kael's Notiz: Das Ziel dieser Mod ist ein rundenbasiertes Spiel mit einer hohen Langzeitmotivation.Ich bin ein grosser Fan der Civilization Reihe, doch nach vielen Spielen fällt auf, daß das Spielgeschehen sich sehr ähnelt. Tatsächlich ist dies sehr bemerkenswert. Welches andere Spiel kann man so häufig spielen, bevor es langweilig wird?[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Das Ziel der Langzeitmotivation haben wir mit folgenden Entscheidungen verfolgt:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1.[TAB]Jede Zivilisation sollte sich komplett von jeder anderen unterscheiden. Statt der Unterscheidung durch einzigartige Einheiten und Gebäude wollen wir den Spieler dazu bringen für jede Zivilisation eigene Strategien und Spielstile zu entwickeln. Wir wissen, daß nicht alle Spieler jede Zivilisation mögen werden, jedoch sollte jeder eine seinem Spielstil entsprechende Zivilisation finden. Spieler die eine neue Erfahrung suchen spielen dann einfach eine Zivilisation, die einen anderen neuen Spielstil erfordern.[NEWLINE]2.[TAB]Die Staatsreligion hat einen gewaltigen Effekt auf die Zivilisation. Daher gibt es eigentlich sieben Versionen jeder Zivilisation (Zivilisation + 7 verschiedene Religionen).[NEWLINE]3.[TAB]Eine generelle Abneigung gegen vorgefertigte Spielschemata. Obwohl einfach zu entwickeln und zu balancieren, sind vorgefertigte Spielschemata im allgemeinen unkreativ. Stattdessen haben wir jede einzelne Option individuell erstellt und auf das gesamte Spiel bezogen balanciert, anstatt die Option an sich zu balancieren. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Daher besitzt Fall from Heaven einen höheren Lernanspruch, als die meisten anderen Spiele. Dies ist der Preis der entwickelten Optionen. Aber einmal erlernt hoffen wir, dass diese Mod komplex genug ist, um dem Spieler für Monate wenn nicht Jahre Spielspaß zu vermitteln.

This is a world where the themes of corruption and redemption are repeated and all the characters, including the gods themselves, are imperfect.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Although the mod isn't a direct translation of any of the following inspiration comes from Celtic and Norse mythology, Judeo-Christian mysticism and the works of Edgar Allen Poe and H.P. TEXT.Spanish: [H1]¿Qué es Fall from Heaven?[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Basado en un largo recorrido de una campaña Dungeons and Dragons, Fall from Heaven se situa en el oscuro mundo de fantasía de Erebus. Es un mundo en el que los temas de la corrupción y la redención se repiten y todos los personajes, incluyendo los mismos dioses, son seres imperfectos.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Aunque el mod no es una traducción directa de ninguna de las siguientes inspiraciones, proviene de la mitología Celta y Nórdica, del misticismo Judeo-Cristiano y de los trabajos de Edgar Allen Poe y H.P. Lovecraft.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Notas de Kael: El objetivo de este mod es aportar un juego de estrategia por turnos con foco en la rejugabilidad. Soy un gran fan de la serie Civilization, pero después de jugar una docena o más partidas, empiezan a parecer lo mismo. Y esto es lo sorprendente, ¿qué otro juego puedes jugar docenas de veces antes de que empiece a parecer lo mismo?[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Hemos perseguido nuestro objetivo de rejugabilidad tomando algunas decisiones clave:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1.[TAB]Cada civilización debería ser fundamentalmente diferente a las otras. Mucho más que una simple diferencia (como una unidad única o un edificio único) queremos que el jugador tenga que adoptar diferentes estrategias y diferentes estilos con cada civilización. Entendimos que no a todos los jugadores les gustaría todas las civilizaciones, pero cada uno encontraría algo que apelaron a su estilo de juego y jugadores por una nueva experiencia que podrían intentar algo que jugaron de manera diferente a lo que solían.[NEWLINE]2.[TAB]La religión oficial de un jugador tendría un dramático efecto en su civilización. Como que realmente hay 7 versiones de cada civilización, una por cada religión.[NEWLINE]3.[TAB]Un descontento general por pautas. Aunque fácil de diseñar y balancear, las pautas son generalmente poco creativas. En lugar de eso creamos cada opción individualmente e intentar equilibrarlo todo en lugar de en la opción específica siendo creada.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Después de todo parece que FfH tiene una curva de aprendizaje más alta que la mayoría de los juegos, todas estas opciones vienen con un coste. Pero una vez aprendidas nuestra esperanza es que hay profundidad suficiente de juego para los jugadores para que lo disfruten durante meses o años.

TEXT.English: World Spells
TEXT.French: Sorts Mondiaux

TEXT.English: [H1]World Spells[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Each civilization was a World Spell they can use. These spells have a huge effect but can only be used once per game so consider carefully before you use them. The following are the world spells for each civilization:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Amurites- [LINK=SPELL_ARCANE_LACUNA]Arcane Lacuna[\LINK][NEWLINE]Balseraphs- [LINK=SPELL_REVELRY]Revelry[\LINK][NEWLINE]Bannor- [LINK=SPELL_RALLY]Rally[\LINK][NEWLINE]Calabim- [LINK=SPELL_RIVER_OF_BLOOD]River of Blood[\LINK][NEWLINE]Clan of Embers- [LINK=SPELL_FOR_THE_HORDE]For the Horde[\LINK][NEWLINE]Doviello- [LINK=SPELL_WILD_HUNT]Wild Hunt[\LINK][NEWLINE]Elohim- [LINK=SPELL_SANCTUARY]Sanctuary[\LINK][NEWLINE]Grigori- [LINK=SPELL_ARDOR]Ardor[\LINK][NEWLINE]Hippus- [LINK=SPELL_HIPPUS]Hippus[\LINK][NEWLINE]Illians- [LINK=SPELL_STASIS]Stasis[\LINK][NEWLINE]Infernal- [LINK=SPELL_HYBOREMS_WHISPER]Hyborem's Whisper[\LINK][NEWLINE]Khazad- [LINK=SPELL_MOTHER_LODE]Mother Lode[\LINK][NEWLINE]Kuriotates- [LINK=SPELL_LEGENDS]Legends[\LINK][NEWLINE]Lanun- [LINK=SPELL_RAGING_SEAS]Raging Seas[\LINK][NEWLINE]Ljosalfar- [LINK=SPELL_MARCH_OF_THE_TREES]March of the Trees[\LINK][NEWLINE]Luchuirp- [LINK=SPELL_GIFTS_OF_NANTOSUELTA]Gifts of Nantosuelta[\LINK][NEWLINE]Malakim- [LINK=SPELL_RELIGIOUS_FERVOR]Religious Fervor[\LINK][NEWLINE]Mercurians- [LINK=SPELL_DIVINE_RETRIBUTION]Divine Retribution[\LINK][NEWLINE]Sheaim- [LINK=SPELL_WORLDBREAK]Worldbreak[\LINK][NEWLINE]Sidar- [LINK=SPELL_INTO_THE_MIST]Into the Mist[\LINK][NEWLINE]Svartalfar- [LINK=SPELL_VEIL_OF_NIGHT]Veil of Night[\LINK][NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Kael's Notes: We added these for two reasons. Of course they help us differentiate each of the civilizations. But we also wanted to add a strategic option where the player was forced to decide when was the best moment to use the ability. As such all of the World Spells generally grow more powerful over time, rewarding players who don't profit from there use early on.

The following are the world spells for each civilization:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Amurites- [LINK=SPELL_ARCANE_LACUNA]Arcane Lacuna[\LINK][NEWLINE]Balseraphs- [LINK=SPELL_REVELRY]Revelry[\LINK][NEWLINE]Bannor- [LINK=SPELL_RALLY]Rally[\LINK][NEWLINE]Calabim- [LINK=SPELL_RIVER_OF_BLOOD]River of Blood[\LINK][NEWLINE]Clan of Embers- [LINK=SPELL_FOR_THE_HORDE]For the Horde[\LINK][NEWLINE]Doviello- [LINK=SPELL_WILD_HUNT]Wild Hunt[\LINK][NEWLINE]Elohim- [LINK=SPELL_SANCTUARY]Sanctuary[\LINK][NEWLINE]Grigori- [LINK=SPELL_ARDOR]Ardor[\LINK][NEWLINE]Hippus- [LINK=SPELL_HIPPUS]Hippus[\LINK][NEWLINE]Illians- [LINK=SPELL_STASIS]Stasis[\LINK][NEWLINE]Infernal- [LINK=SPELL_HYBOREMS_WHISPER]Hyborem's Whisper[\LINK][NEWLINE]Khazad- [LINK=SPELL_MOTHER_LODE]Mother Lode[\LINK][NEWLINE]Kuriotates- [LINK=SPELL_LEGENDS]Legends[\LINK][NEWLINE]Lanun- [LINK=SPELL_RAGING_SEAS]Raging Seas[\LINK][NEWLINE]Ljosalfar- [LINK=SPELL_MARCH_OF_THE_TREES]March of the Trees[\LINK][NEWLINE]Luchuirp- [LINK=SPELL_GIFTS_OF_NANTOSUELTA]Gifts of Nantosuelta[\LINK][NEWLINE]Malakim- [LINK=SPELL_RELIGIOUS_FERVOR]Religious Fervor[\LINK][NEWLINE]Mercurians- [LINK=SPELL_DIVINE_RETRIBUTION]Divine Retribution[\LINK][NEWLINE]Sheaim- [LINK=SPELL_WORLDBREAK]Worldbreak[\LINK][NEWLINE]Sidar- [LINK=SPELL_INTO_THE_MIST]Into the Mist[\LINK][NEWLINE]Svartalfar- [LINK=SPELL_VEIL_OF_NIGHT]Veil of Night[\LINK][NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Kael's Notes: We added these for two reasons. Of course they help us differentiate each of the civilizations. But we also wanted to add a strategic option where the player was forced to decide when was the best moment to use the ability. As such all of the World Spells generally grow more powerful over time, rewarding players who don't profit from there use early on.

TEXT.English: Grigori - Adventurers and Refugees
TEXT.French: Grigori - Adventurers and Refugees

TEXT.English:
Grigori are able to trigger spawns of two different unit types: the [LINK=UNIT_ADVENTURER]Adventurer[\LINK] and the [LINK=UNIT_REFUGEE]Refugee.[\LINK] The former is a hero unit that can upgrade into any unitclass you have access to (An adept, a warrior, a scout, etc.) And the latter is a non-hero unit that can also upgrade into any unit class, but with a random racial promotion (Orc, Dwarf, Giant, etc.).
The Adventurer is earned much like a great person, by generating adventurer points every turn until a new adventurer is born. Each new adventurer requires 20 more points than the previous one (100, 120, 140, etc.).
Additives:
+1 Base point per turn.
+0.33 For every Grigori Temple building.
+0.33 For every Museum building.
+1 For every Tavern building.
+0.5 For every Adventurers Guild building.
+1 For every Dwelling of Refuge building.
+1 For every Crime Bounty building.
+2 If Apprenticeship civic.
+0.33 For every Statesman specialist if Forum building is present.
Multipliers:
*1.25 If Apprenticeship civic.
And the Refugee:
Each city has a chance to spawn a Refugee each turn if the following buildings are present in the city:
+4% for Memorial of the Refugee.
+2% for Dwelling of Refuge.

TEXT.English: Mekara - Aspirants
TEXT.French: Mekara - Aspirants

TEXT.English:
Mekara, under the rule of Iram Damar, is able to trigger spawns of the [LINK=UNIT_ASPIRANT]Aspirant.[\LINK] The Aspirant is a unit that can upgrade into any unit class and grows stronger with age. An Aspirant who is transformed into an Ascendant is more powerful than other Ascendants.
The Aspirant is earned much like a great person, by generating Aspirant points every turn until a new Aspirant is born. Each new Aspirant requires 20 more points than the previous one (100, 120, 140, etc.).
Additives:
+3 Base points per turn.
+2 for every Shaper Cabal building.
+1 for every Shaper's Laboratory building.
+2 for Slavery civic.
+0.5 for every Healer and Elder if Shaper's Laboratory building is present.
+1 for every Great Healer and Great Elder if Shaper's Laboratory building is present.
Multipliers:
*1.25 if Slavery.

TEXT.English: Alignment
TEXT.French: Alignement

TEXT.English: [H1]Alignment[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Rise from Erebus features a DnD-style alignment system, with 9 possible alignments on two seperate axes. These axes are Good, Neutral, and Evil, and Lawful, Neutral, and Chaotic. Each leader starts with one from each axis, and some units and civics can only be used by players of a specific alignment. They also affect your diplomatic relations with other players, granting you bonuses to players of the same alignment (on that axis) and negatives to players of other alignments. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Without the Broader Alignments game option selected, the only way to change your alignment is by adopting a State Religion. With the Broader Alignments option, many additional things can affect alignment; Units, Spells, Promotions, Events, Civics, Buildings. Some of these can only do so in lump-sum amounts, while others are able to do so via prolonged effects. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Available Alignment combinations: Lawful Good, Neutral Good, Chaotic Good, Lawful Neutral, True Neutral, Chaotic Neutral, Lawful Evil, Neutral Evil, and Chaotic Evil.
TEXT.French: [H1]Alignement[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Rise from Erebus implémente un système d'alignement basé sur Donjons et Dragons, contenant 9 alignements possibles sur deux axes distincts.[NEWLINE]Ces axes sont:[NEWLINE][TAB]Bon, Neutre et Mauvais[NEWLINE][TAB]Loyal, Neutre et Chaotique.[NEWLINE]Chaque dirigeant commence en étant positionné sur ces deux axes (ex. Loyal Bon).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Certaines unités et doctrines ne peuvent être utilisées que par les joueurs d'un alignement spécifique.[NEWLINE]Elles affectent également les relations diplomatiques avec les autres joueurs, vous conférant des bonus diplomatiques avec les joueurs de même alignement (sur un axe donné) et des malus avec les joueurs d'alignement différent.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Sans avoir activé l'option des alignements enrichis, la seule façon de changer d'alignement est d'adopter une Religion d'État.Avec l'option activée, de nombreuses choses peuvent affecter votre alignement: unités, sorts, promotions, évènements, doctrines, constructions. Certaines influent de manière fixe, tandis que d'autres ont une influence à long terme.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Les combinaisons possibles d'alignements sont : Loyal Bon, Neutre Bon, Chaotique Bon, Loyal Neutre, Neutre Neutre (Vrai Neutre), Chaotic Neutre, Loyal Mauvais, Neutre Mauvais et Chaotique Mauvais.
TEXT.German: [H1]Gesinnung[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Rise from Erebus enthält ein DnD (Dungeons'n'Dragons) Gesinnungssystem, das sich aus 9 unterschiedlichen Gesinnungen, die durch zwei Axen bestimmt werden. Die eine Achse enthält Gut, Neutral und Böse, die andere enthält Rechtschaffen, Neutral und Chaotisch. Jeder Anführer beginnt mit je einer Eigenschaft von jeder Achse, manche Einheiten und Staatsformen im Spiel können nur von Spielern mit einer bestimmten Gesinnung gewählt werden. Die Gesinnungen haben außerdem Einfluss auf die diplomatischen Beziehungen mit anderen Völkern, indem sie Boni für Spieler derselben Gesinnung und Mali bei Spielern einer anderen Gesinnung liefern. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Ohne die Aktivierung der Breiteren Gesinnung im Spiel ist die einzige Möglichkeit, die eigene Gesinnung zu ändern, die Annahme von Staatsreligionen. Durch die Option Bereitere Gesinnung können viele weitere Dinge die Gesinnung beeinflussen. Einheiten, Zauber, Beförderungen, Ereignisse, Staatsformen, Gebäude. Manche von diesen verändern nur in geringem Maße etwas, während wieder andere über einen langen Zeitraum Wirkung entfalten.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Verfügbare Kombinationen der Gesinnungen sind: [NEWLINE]Rechtschaffen Gut[NEWLINE]Neutral Gut[NEWLINE]Chaotisch Gut[NEWLINE]Rechtschaffen Neutral[NEWLINE]Neutral Neutral[NEWLINE]Chaotisch Neutral[NEWLINE]Rechtschaffen Böse[NEWLINE]Neutral Böse[NEWLINE]Chaotisch Böse.

TEXT.English: Altitude (hills and peaks)
TEXT.French: Altitude (Collines et Montagnes)

TEXT.English: Altitude is a hidden property of tiles. It can have 4 values: water, flatland, hills or peak. Peaks are impassable for standard units (except mountaineer or flying). Movement cost for hills is 2.
TEXT.French: L'altitude est un propriété cachée des cases, qui peut prendre 4 valeurs : Eau, plaine, colline ou montagne. Les Montagnes sont infranchissables pour les unités standard (sauf les Montagnards ou les unités volantes), de même pour les cases d'eau (sauf pour les unités maritimes et volantes). Le coût en mouvement des collines est de 2.

TEXT.English: Mercenaries
TEXT.French: Mercenaires

TEXT.English:
[H1]Animal Spawning[\H1] Doviello cities periodically have a chance to spawn animals. [NEWLINE]Various National Wonders are required to allow each type of animal to spawn. Construction of these wonders also allows units built in the city to have a Kindred Spirit promotion. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=UNIT_WOLF]Wolves[\LINK] - Available from start. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=UNIT_BOAR]Boars[\LINK] - [LINK=BUILDING_BOAR_PEN]Boar Den[\LINK], available with [LINK=TECH_EDUCATION]Education[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=UNIT_BEAR]Bears[\LINK] - [LINK=BUILDING_BEAR_DEN]Bear Den[\LINK], available with [LINK=TECH_MINING]Mining[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=UNIT_GORILLA]Gorillas[\LINK] - [LINK=BUILDING_GORILLA_HUT]Gorilla Hut[\LINK], available with [LINK=TECH_CARTOGRAPHY]Cartography[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=UNIT_GRIFFON]Griffons[\LINK] - [LINK=BUILDING_GRIFFIN_WEYR]Griffon Weyr[\LINK], available with [LINK=TECH_ANIMAL_HUSBANDRY]Animal Husbandry[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=UNIT_STAG]Stags[\LINK] - [LINK=BUILDING_STAG_COPSE]Stag Copse[\LINK], available with [LINK=TECH_PHILOSOPHY]Philosophy[\LINK].
Here is the modifiers that dictate animal spawn chance: Per city spawn chance: +8% Base per turn. -0.6% per population after 1. (Animals are scared of too many people.) +0.5% for Bear Cave. +0.5% for Gorilla Forest. +0.5% for Lion Savanna. +0.5% for Tiger Mangrove. +0.5% for Wolf Burrow. +1% for Crime Ravenous Pack. +1% for Crime Ravenous Pack (Esus Var).
multipliers: *2 if Wild Council civic. *1.5 if Fellowship of Leaves religion.

[ICON_BULLET][LINK=UNIT_GORILLA]Gorillas[\LINK] - [LINK=BUILDING_GORILLA_HUT]Gorilla Hut[\LINK], available with [LINK=TECH_CARTOGRAPHY]Cartography[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=UNIT_GRIFFON]Griffons[\LINK] - [LINK=BUILDING_GRIFFIN_WEYR]Griffon Weyr[\LINK], available with [LINK=TECH_ANIMAL_HUSBANDRY]Animal Husbandry[\LINK]. Here is the modifiers that dictate animal spawn chance: Per city spawn chance: +8% Base per turn. -0.6% per population after 1. (Animals are scared of too many people.) +0.5% for Bear Cave. +0.5% for Gorilla Forest. +0.5% for Lion Savanna. +0.5% for Tiger Mangrove. +0.5% for Wolf Burrow. +1% for Crime Ravenous Pack. +1% for Crime Ravenous Pack (Esus Var).
multipliers: *2 if Wild Council civic. *1.5 if Fellowship of Leaves religion.

TEXT.French: Apparition d'Animaux

TEXT.English: Movement Costs
TEXT.French: Coût de déplacement

TEXT.English: [H1]Needed Knowledge[\H1][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Every unit has a "Movement" which is the number of standard tiles it can move in one turn. For example, a warrior's movement is 1 and a horseman's movement is 3.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]The movement cost is computed for each tile passed through and substracted from the unit movement until it reaches 0.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Movement is a decimal value, but you only see the integer part. For example, if a warrior (movement 1) makes a move that costs him 0.5, his remaining movement becomes 0.5/1, but you still see 1 in the details. If he makes another move costing 0.5, he now has movement 0/1 and can't move anymore on this turn.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Each tile contains a base terrain, a feature and an altitude. These three characteristics can have a movement cost modifier, which translates the difficulty to move through it.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Routes (roads, railroads, trails) can help movement.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Crossing a river costs more movement points.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Some tiles are impassable: mountain (an altitude), volcano (a feature), water (except for naval units of course),... [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Some units ([LINK=PROMOTION_FLYING]flying[\LINK], [LINK=PROMOTION_MONSTROUS_CREATURE]monstrous creature[\LINK]) ignore terrain, feature and altitude costs, route bonuses, river crossing malus and can move through impassable terrain.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Some units have specific movement bonuses : [LINK=PROMOTION_ELF]elves[\LINK] in forests (a feature), [LINK=PROMOTION_DWARF]dwarves[\LINK] on hills (an altitude).[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Some units have specific movement maluses : [LINK=PROMOTION_LIZARDMAN]lizardmen[\LINK] in tundra (a base terrain), [LINK=PROMOTION_ELF]alfar[\LINK] in forests (a feature)[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Some units have specific movement multipliers : [LINK=PROMOTION_WASTELAND_DEFENDER]wasteland defenders[\LINK] in wasteland (a base terrain), [LINK=PROMOTION_WOODSMAN2]units with Woodsman 2[\LINK] in forests (a feature), [LINK=PROMOTION_GUERILLA2]units with Guerilla 2[\LINK] on hills (an altitude).[NEWLINE][H1]Mathematics[\H1]This part will involve a lot of easy maths operations (just the 4 common operators: + - * and /)[H2]Variable template[\H2][ICON_BULLET]Variables who can be true (=1) or false (=0) will have "bool" in their name (as in boolean)[H2]Costs[\H2][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Each base terrain has its movement cost:[COLOR_REVERT][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]grass_cost = plain_cost = taiga_cost = 1[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]marsh_cost = glacier_cost = tundra_cost = wasteland_cost = 2[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]desert_cost = 3[NEWLINE][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Each Feature has its movement cost:[COLOR_REVERT][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]empty_cost = 1[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]forest_cost = jungle_cost=oasis_cost = 2[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]ancient_forest_cost = scrubs_cost = 3[NEWLINE][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Each Altitude has its movement cost:[COLOR_REVERT][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]flat_cost = 1[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]hills_cost = 2[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]peak_cost = 4[NEWLINE][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Each route has its movement bonus:[COLOR_REVERT][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]road_bonus = trail_bonus = 2[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]railroad_bonus = 4[H2]Formulas[\H2][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Route multiplier, based on the type of route on the initial tile:[COLOR_REVERT][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]ROAD --> route_multiplier = road_bonus + [LINK=TECH_ENGINEERING]bool_has_tech_engineering[\LINK][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]RAILROAD --> route_multiplier = railroad_bonus + 4 * [LINK=TECH_ENGINEERING]bool_has_tech_engineering[\LINK][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]TRAIL --> route_multiplier = trail_bonus * [LINK=PROMOTION_LIZARDMAN]bool_is_lizardman[\LINK][NEWLINE][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]We consider terrain, altitude and feature on the arriving tile:[COLOR_REVERT][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]move_cost_malus = terrain_cost + altitude_cost + feature_cost - 2[NEWLINE]We consider units bonuses, for example dwarves bonus on hills[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]move_cost = specific_multiplier * (move_cost_malus + specific_malus - specific_bonus)/route_multiplier[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]remaining_move_points = initial_move_points-move_cost[H1]Example[\H1]elven scout moves from grassland/road towards grassland/hills/forest
TEXT.French: [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Chaque unité a un "Mouvement" qui est le nombre de cases standard dont elle peut se déplacer par tour. Par exemple, le mouvement d'un guerrier est de 1 et celui d'un cavalier est de 3.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Le coût en mouvement est calculé pour chaque case franchie et soustrait au mouvement total de l'unité jusqu'à atteindre 0.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Le mouvement est une valeur décimale, mais vous ne pouvez en voir que la partie entière. Par exemple, si un guerrier (mouvement 1) fait un déplacement qui lui coûte 0.5, son mouvement restant est de 0.5/1, mais la valeur affichée est toujours 1. S'il effectue un autre mouvement qui lui coûte 0.5 de mouvement, il aura alors 0/1 en mouvement et ne pourra plus se déplacer jusqu'à la fin du tour.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Chaque case est constituée d'un terrain de base, d'un attribut et d'une altitude. Cette combinaison peut influencer le coût en déplacement, qui représente la difficulté à la traverser.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Les Routes (routes, rails, ou sentiers) permettent de faciliter la traversée des cases (donc de réduire le coût en mouvement).[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Traverser une rivière coûte plus de points de mouvement.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Certaines cases sont infranchissables : les montagnes (altitude), un volcan (un attribut), l'eau (sauf pour les unités volantes et navales bien sûr),...[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Certaines unités (par exemple [LINK=PROMOTION_FLYING]volantes[\LINK], [LINK=PROMOTION_MONSTROUS_CREATURE]créature monstrueuse[\LINK]) ignorent les coûts liés au terrain, à l'attribut et à l'altitude, les bonus liés aux routes, les malus liés à la traversée des rivières et peuvent traverser les zones naturellement infranchissables.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Certaines unités ont des bonus de mouvement spécifiques: Par exemple, les [LINK=PROMOTION_ELF]elfes[\LINK] dans les forêts (un attribut), les [LINK=PROMOTION_DWARF]nains[\LINK] sur les collines (une altitude).[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Certaines unités ont des malus de mouvement spécifiques: par exemple, les [LINK=PROMOTION_LIZARDMAN]Hommes-Lézards[\LINK] dans la toundra (un terrain de base), les [LINK=PROMOTION_ELF]alfar[\LINK] dans les forêts (un attribut). [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Certaines unités ont des multiplicateurs de mouvement spécifiques : les [LINK=PROMOTION_WASTELAND_DEFENDER]défenseurs des terres stériles[\LINK] dans les terres stériles (un terrain de base), les unités avec [LINK=PROMOTION_WOODSMAN2]Forestier 2[\LINK] dans les forêts (un attribut), les unités avec [LINK=PROMOTION_GUERILLA2]Guerilla 2[\LINK] sur les collines (une altitude).[NEWLINE][H1]Calculs[\H1]Cette section utilise beaucoup les 4 opérations de base (à savoir + - * / )[H2]Variable template[\H2][ICON_BULLET]Les varibales qui peuvent être vraies (=1) ou fausses (=0) contiennent "bool" dans leurs noms (comme pour booléen)[H2]Coûts[\H2][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Chaque terrain de base a son coût de mouvement propre:[COLOR_REVERT][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]prairie_cout = plaine_cout = taïga_cout = 1[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]marais_cost = glacier_cout = toundra_cout = terreperdue_cout = 2[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]désert_cout = 3[NEWLINE][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Chaque attribut a son coût de mouvement propre:[COLOR_REVERT][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]vide_cout = 1[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]foret_cout = jungle_cout=oasis_cout = 2[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]foret_ancienne_cout = broussailles_cout = 3[NEWLINE][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Chaque Altitude a son coût de mouvement propre:[COLOR_REVERT][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]plat_cout = 1[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]colline_cout = 2[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]montagne_cout = 4[NEWLINE][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Chaque route a son coût de mouvement propre:[COLOR_REVERT][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]route_bonus = piste_bonus = 2[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]voieferree_bonus = 4[H2]Formules[\H2][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Multiplicateur de route, basé sur le type de route de la case de départ:[COLOR_REVERT][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]ROUTE --> route_multiplicateur = route_bonus + [LINK=TECH_ENGINEERING]bool_possede_tech_ingenierie[\LINK][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]VOIEFERREE --> route_multiplicateur = voieferree_bonus + 4 * [LINK=TECH_ENGINEERING]bool_possede_tech_ingenierie[\LINK][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]PISTE --> route_multiplicateur = piste_bonus * [LINK=PROMOTION_LIZARDMAN]bool_est_un_hommelezard[\LINK][NEWLINE][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Considérons le terrain, l'altitude et l'attribut de la case d'arrivée:[COLOR_REVERT][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]deplacement_cout_malus = terrain_cout + altitude_cout + attribut_cout - 2[NEWLINE]Prenons en compte les bonus des unités (les nains dans les collines par exemple)[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]deplacement_cout = multiplicateur_specifique * (deplacement_cout_malus + malus_specifique - bonus_specifique) / route_multiplicateury[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]points_de_mouvement_restant = points_de_mouvement_initiaux-deplacement_cout[H1]Exemple[\H1]Éclaireur elfe se déplaçant d'une prairie/route vers une prairie/colline/forêt

TEXT.English: Mekara Order - Sluga Units
TEXT.French: Mekara Order - Sluga Units

TEXT.English: [H1]Sluga Units:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE] The Sluga units are much like Golem units, in that they do not gain any experience on their own (due to not having a unitclass). Unlike the Golems, however, they have no real utility on their own, being mostly useless without a Commander with the [LINK=PROMOTION_COM_OVERSEER_V2]Overseer Command[\LINK] Promotion.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] Commanders with Overseer Command improve the workrate of all Sluga unit types dramatically. With the proper Technology, the [LINK=UNIT_OVERSEER_V2]Overseer[\LINK] can also provide Slugas unit types with terraforming capabilities. Terraforming spells are: [LINK=SPELL_SCORCH_MEKARA_V2]Scorch[\LINK] at Divination. [LINK=SPELL_SPRING_MEKARA_V2]Spring[\LINK] at Elementalism. [LINK=SPELL_BLOOM_MEKARA_V2]Bloom[\LINK] at Alteration. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE] The [LINK=UNIT_COMBAT_OVERSEER_V2]Combat Overseer[\LINK], on the other hand, can grant Sluga unit types with combat support spells such as [LINK=SPELL_REGENERATION_MEKARA_V2]Regeneration[\LINK], [LINK=SPELL_MAELSTROM_MEKARA1]Maelstrom[\LINK], and [LINK=SPELL_STONESKIN_MEKARA]Stoneskin[\LINK]. The promotions that better Overseers or commanders can give are, among other things, increased Combat Strength, First Strikes, resistance to Collateral Damage, And Ranged Attacks.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Sluga units can also be controlled by [LINK=UNIT_COMMANDER]Great Generals.[\LINK][NEWLINE][NEWLINE] The Sluga and Battle Sluga are created through a spell castable by Slave units, in cities that have the [LINK=BUILDING_SHAPER_CABAL]Shaper Cabal[\LINK] building, Sluga at Knowledge of the Ether, and Battle Sluga at Alteration. War Sluga, meanwhile, are upgraded from Battle Sluga, while the Behemoth unit can only be created through a [LINK=SPELL_BEHEMOTH_CREATION_V2]Create Behemoth spell[\LINK] available at Arcane Lore. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Slugas and Combat Overseers are only available to the Mekara leader Jamal Dahkar.

[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] The [LINK=UNIT_COMBAT_OVERSEER_V2]Combat Overseer[\LINK], on the other hand, can grant Sluga unit types with combat support spells such as [LINK=SPELL_REGENERATION_MEKARA_V2]Regeneration[\LINK], [LINK=SPELL_MAELSTROM_MEKARA1]Maelstrom[\LINK], and [LINK=SPELL_STONESKIN_MEKARA]Stoneskin[\LINK]. The promotions that better Overseers or commanders can give are, among other things, increased Combat Strength, First Strikes, resistance to Collateral Damage, And Ranged Attacks.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Sluga units can also be controlled by [LINK=UNIT_COMMANDER]Great Generals.[\LINK][NEWLINE][NEWLINE] The Sluga and Battle Sluga are created through a spell castable by Slave units, in cities that have the [LINK=BUILDING_SHAPER_CABAL]Shaper Cabal[\LINK] building, Sluga at Knowledge of the Ether, and Battle Sluga at Alteration. War Sluga, meanwhile, are upgraded from Battle Sluga, while the Behemoth unit can only be created through a [LINK=SPELL_BEHEMOTH_CREATION_V2]Create Behemoth spell[\LINK] available at Arcane Lore. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Slugas and Combat Overseers are only available to the Mekara leader Jamal Dahkar.

TEXT.English: Mekara Order - Gladitorial Games
TEXT.French: Mekara Order - Gladitorial Games

TEXT.English: [H1]Gladitorial Games:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE] Gladitorial Games is a temporary building constructed in a city whenever a [LINK=UNIT_SLAVE]Slave[\LINK] unit casts the [LINK=SPELL_ENTER_ARENA]Enter Arena[\LINK] spell. This building gives the city increased culture and happiness while the games continue. The games end when either the unit dies (20% chance each turn), or the unit wins the games (25% change each turn). Should the unit win the games, the player will be given a [LINK=UNIT_GLADIATOR]Gladiator[\LINK] unit to use, which is a powerful, melee unit. If the Slave unit dies, the games end, and nothing else happens.

TEXT.English: Mekara Order - Unit Augmentations
TEXT.French: Mekara Order - Unit Augmentations

TEXT.English: [H1]Unit Augmentations:[\H1] [PARAGRAPH:1] The [LINK=UNIT_SHAPER]Shaper[\LINK] and [LINK=UNIT_HIGHMAGE]High Mage[\LINK] units have an ability which lets them improve other units. This ability works as follows:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]First the mage casts the [LINK=SPELL_RITUAL_PREPARATION]Ritual Preparation[\LINK] spell. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Once the mage has cast this spell, all units in the stack gain the ability to cast the [LINK=SPELL_RITUAL_TARGET_DESIGNATE]Designate Ritual Target[\LINK] spell, which marks it as the target of the ritual, with a promotion.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] After the target has been designated in this way, the mage can cast any of the Aspect spells, which applies a number of effects, chosen at random, to the unit (the actual effects depend on the Aspect chosen).[PARAGRAPH:1][H2]Aspects:[\H2][PARAGRAPH:1]Each of the Aspect spells has a number of mana types associated with it, and each Mana resource in excess of one will add another potential effect. The second and third ranks of the spell sphere promotions will also each add one more effect. Each Aspect has both beneficial and detrimental effects, as well as rare special effects that can be applied. They also each have a 'base' effect, that is applied no matter what. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Aspect of the Beserker [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Mana Types: Body and Force [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Beneficial Effects: Offensive Strength, Heal through Combat, City Attack [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Detrimental Effects: Defensive Strength, Passive Heal Rate, City Defence [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Special Effects: Can Attack Multiple Times and Enhanced Strength [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Base Effects: +2 Attack Strength [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Aspect of the Protector [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Mana Types: Earth and Law [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Beneficial Effects: Passive Heal Rate, Defensive Strength, City and Hill Defence [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Detrimental Effects: Increased Terrain Cost, Withdraw Chance, Offensive Strength [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Special Effects: Resistances, First Strikes and Defensive Strength [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Base Effects: +2 Defence Strength [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Aspect of the Assassin [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Mana Types: Air and Shadow [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Beneficial Effects: First Strikes, Withdrawal Chance, Increased Movement, Heal While Moving [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Detrimental Effects: Defensive Strength, City Attack [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Special Effects: Flying [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Base Effects: -1 Terrain Movement Cost, +5% Withdraw Cance, +1-3 First Strikes [NEWLINE]In addition to this, there are also generic effects that are applied with all Aspects: [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Beneficial Effects: Slightly increased Combat Strength, Extra First Strike Chances [SPACE][SPACE][SPACE]Detrimental Effects: Slightly decreased Combat Strength, Negative First Strike Chances

TEXT.English: Scions of Patria - Gaining Population
TEXT.French: Scions of Patria - Gaining Population

TEXT.English:
The greatest difference between the Scions and the other civs is how the Scions gain population. As a Fallow civ the Scions don't gain population via food and normal growth. Instead they must lure Awakened from the Bottomless Tomb, create Reborn, or capture cities. [H1]Awakened:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE] Citizens of long-departed Patria, the Age of Magic's greatest empire, are the the core population of the Scions of Patria. They have been given the Gift, but they still must be brought out of the Bottomless Tomb. Awakened may be "built" in the capital. Structures much like bridges are extended into the Tomb and used to find and ferry the honored dead back into the world. But they are very expensive and inevitably temporary. After a short time they become animate and unalive, like everything in the Tomb, and may no longer be used. Awakened gained this way are expensive. But they honored dead are hard to predict - you'll often be forced to go in after them. The easiest way for the Scions to get population is for an Awakened just walk out of the capital's Bottomless Tomb of it's own free will. But while the Tomb is bottomless an endless army of Awakened won't be coming: They have their own alien amusements there. The longer they stay the less willing they are to leave. The frequency with which Awakened emerge is displayed in the message area and can be increased by the player's actions. Building Shrines to Kylorin, Imperial Cenotaphs or Temples of the Gift, Halls of the Covenant, or the Flesh Studio all attract Awakened. Most luxuries will help lure Awakened. Of special note is the "Patrian Artifacts" resource. Only the Scions player can see these resources, and unlike the other luxuries each resource owned increases the odds. The larger, more bustling the Capital the more will Awakened are to emerge. And when society is explicitly run for the benefit of the Awakened, "Aristocracy", Awakened are more likely to come forth. [H1]Reborn:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE] Reborn are formerly living inhabitants of Erebus granted the Gift and transformed into undead Scions. There are five ways to gain Reborn. First, Reborn can be created from combat with a priest of the Gift - A Legate, a Doomsayer, or a Doomgiver. The enemy unit is persuaded that unlife among the Scions is preferable to their present meager existence. Second, Reborn can be "built" in a city containing a Cathedral of Rebirth. Third, Pelemoc Goldtongue may persaude the citizens of other civilzations to join Patria Reborn. Fourth, once the Scions have Sorcery and Priesthood a razed city will yield a few Reborn. Finally, the Dark Council generates three Reborn the turn it is established. Capturing cities: Of course anyone can do this. All you need is a bunch of guys with swords. However, the lifestyles of other civs isn't very compatible with the unlifestyle of the Scions. When a city changes hands to or from the Scions most of the population is lost. This reduction isn't as great if the Scions are using the "God King" civic. [H1]Details on Awakened Spawning:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE] The formula determining the odds an Awakened appear each turn isn't complicated(lies), but it is rather long: Total pop cap to spawn Awa: max(10, Total Land plots / 2) Total pop cap refers to the sum of city populations + number of awakened + number of reborn. Starting from half of the total pop cap a linearly decreasing multiplier is applied to a spawn chance: multi = 1 at 50% cap, = 0 at 100% cap AI gets Awa at capital with a 50% chance, random city 50%. The base chance for a Standard-sized world is: Additive modifiers: - +3% Base - +5% Aristocracy - +0.5% for every Happy Bonus type (not total) - +1% for each Body Mana if at least 1 Flesh Studio is present - +1% for each Patrian Artifact resource - +5% if Remnants of Patria is owned - +0.5% for each Temple of the Gift - +1% for each Imperial Cenotaph - +1% for each Hall of the Covenant - +0.5% for each Shrine to Kylorin - -2% for each Unhealthy Discontent I - -4% for each Unhealthy Discontent II
Multiplicative modifiers: - *1.5 if Total pop is under (6) - GrowthPercent (*0.34 Marathon, *0.67 Epic, *1.5 Quick) - *1.25 for God King if Emperor or Kounperor - *1.25 for Aristocracy if Korinna

After a short time they become animate and unalive, like everything in the Tomb, and may no longer be used. Awakened gained this way are expensive. But they honored dead are hard to predict - you'll often be forced to go in after them. The easiest way for the Scions to get population is for an Awakened just walk out of the capital's Bottomless Tomb of it's own free will. But while the Tomb is bottomless an endless army of Awakened won't be coming: They have their own alien amusements there. The longer they stay the less willing they are to leave. The frequency with which Awakened emerge is displayed in the message area and can be increased by the player's actions. Building Shrines to Kylorin, Imperial Cenotaphs or Temples of the Gift, Halls of the Covenant, or the Flesh Studio all attract Awakened. Most luxuries will help lure Awakened. Of special note is the "Patrian Artifacts" resource. Only the Scions player can see these resources, and unlike the other luxuries each resource owned increases the odds. The larger, more bustling the Capital the more will Awakened are to emerge. And when society is explicitly run for the benefit of the Awakened, "Aristocracy", Awakened are more likely to come forth. [H1]Reborn:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE] Reborn are formerly living inhabitants of Erebus granted the Gift and transformed into undead Scions. There are five ways to gain Reborn. First, Reborn can be created from combat with a priest of the Gift - A Legate, a Doomsayer, or a Doomgiver. The enemy unit is persuaded that unlife among the Scions is preferable to their present meager existence. Second, Reborn can be "built" in a city containing a Cathedral of Rebirth. Third, Pelemoc Goldtongue may persaude the citizens of other civilzations to join Patria Reborn. Fourth, once the Scions have Sorcery and Priesthood a razed city will yield a few Reborn. Finally, the Dark Council generates three Reborn the turn it is established. Capturing cities: Of course anyone can do this. All you need is a bunch of guys with swords. However, the lifestyles of other civs isn't very compatible with the unlifestyle of the Scions. When a city changes hands to or from the Scions most of the population is lost. This reduction isn't as great if the Scions are using the "God King" civic. [H1]Details on Awakened Spawning:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE] The formula determining the odds an Awakened appear each turn isn't complicated(lies), but it is rather long: Total pop cap to spawn Awa: max(10, Total Land plots / 2) Total pop cap refers to the sum of city populations + number of awakened + number of reborn. Starting from half of the total pop cap a linearly decreasing multiplier is applied to a spawn chance: multi = 1 at 50% cap, = 0 at 100% cap AI gets Awa at capital with a 50% chance, random city 50%. The base chance for a Standard-sized world is: Additive modifiers: - +3% Base - +5% Aristocracy - +0.5% for every Happy Bonus type (not total) - +1% for each Body Mana if at least 1 Flesh Studio is present - +1% for each Patrian Artifact resource - +5% if Remnants of Patria is owned - +0.5% for each Temple of the Gift - +1% for each Imperial Cenotaph - +1% for each Hall of the Covenant - +0.5% for each Shrine to Kylorin - -2% for each Unhealthy Discontent I - -4% for each Unhealthy Discontent II
Multiplicative modifiers: - *1.5 if Total pop is under (6) - GrowthPercent (*0.34 Marathon, *0.67 Epic, *1.5 Quick) - *1.25 for God King if Emperor or Kounperor - *1.25 for Aristocracy if Korinna

TEXT.English: Scions of Patria - The Dark Council
TEXT.French: Scions of Patria - The Dark Council
TEXT.German: Scionen von Patria - Das Dunkle Konzil
TEXT.Italian: Scions of Patria - The Dark Council
TEXT.Spanish: Scions of Patria - The Dark Council

TEXT.English: [H1]The Councilors[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Patria was blessed with many men and women of enormous accomplishment. Patria Rebon shares in that blessing and the Age of Magic's greatest Princes and Poets, Warriors and Merchants, daily walk its streets. The Emperor has appointed four such persons special roles in the Age of Rebirth. Not just undead but unconquerable, if destroyed they always pay heed to the Emperor's call and re-emerge from the great Tomb. Each has his or her special role, and together they lead the Scions Dark Council.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][BOLD]Alcinus - The Mad Thaumaturge[\BOLD] Emerges from the Tomb with Knowledge of the Ether. He founds the essential Thaumaturge's Keep in any city outside the capital (the Apparat refuses to allow it near the Palace) and plays an important part in the Empire's Rituals. Subject to periodic bouts of violent madness, the great mage occasionally turns against his own people. At that point there is nothing that may be done but running him down. A new death returns him to the Emperor. Though even that's not certain. Should he go rogue and join a rival civilization the Scions specially trained wizard-hunters - the Emperor's Daggers - will seek him out.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][BOLD]Themoch, the Silent Watcher[\BOLD] - Unseen but far from sightless, as patient as the grave, at "Tracking" Themoch rides forth, the perfect sentry and spy.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][BOLD]Pelemoc Goldtongue[\BOLD] - He appears most often as a well-off merchant, but will appear in other guises if they serve his need. Pelemoc is no mage, but he bends minds and scatters armies with his mastery of money, with his silver-tongue.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][BOLD]Melante, the Artful Governor[\BOLD] - Head of the Dark Council, Melante is knows as much of the ways of men as Pelemoc, and is just as deft with words. But where he persuades, she rules. Any city with Melante as it's governor will be markedly more productive.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]The Dark Council[\H1][PARAGRAPH:1]Once all four leading Councilors are together in a city outside the capital Melante may found the Dark Council, casting the Scions of Patria World Spell. The Dark Council world-wonder is created. The Dark Council grants three Reborn, and it's ongoing activities foster both trade in Scions cities and discontent among their enemies.

TEXT.English: Scions of Patria - The Haunted Lands
TEXT.French: Scions of Patria - The Haunted Lands
TEXT.Italian: Scions of Patria - The Haunted Lands
TEXT.Spanish: Scions of Patria - The Haunted Lands

TEXT.English: [H1]The Haunted Lands[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]It is the nature of the world that everything is itself. This may seem a truism, but it does not hold in the Haunted Lands. The Haunted Lands join everything together, in the Haunted Lands things *blur*. Notably the line between death and life. There life, of a sort, is found in death and death, of a sort, is found in life.[PARAGRAPH:1]Eating anything grown within the Haunted Lands is very difficult. The grain may scream when harvested and make bread that crumbles into something like bone meal when baked. Its beer could taste and smell of nightmares. Cattle tend to be stillborn, which makes it all the more disturbing as the herds continue to grow.[PARAGRAPH:1]Nevertheless there is much wealth to be found in the Haunted Lands for the brave of heart and strong of stomach. Examples: A tree with branches that when aged and dried taste of nectar and honey, after being killed and cooked, of course. A stream lined with trainable, watchful stones. A pit full of knowledgeable darkness.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Use Haunted Lands to defend Patria Reborn or spoil the territories of your enemies. The Haunted Lands are not well suited to the living.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Undead have a natural affinity to the Haunted Lands. Their senses are sharpened, their arms strong. The Haunted Lands are also a source of many wonders... often grotesque or terrible. The useful ones can be kept or traded so others may appreciate the Gift. The useless ones - and there are many - can be a burden to any nearby living land. The Haunted Lands will foster Unhealth in nearby cities.[PARAGRAPH:1]Perhaps most disturbing, at least to those who haven't accepted the Emperor's Gift, is that those bearing wounds in the Haunted Lands do not always heal true. The substance of the Haunted Lands, or the lack thereof, enters their flesh. They become undead. Some carry on afterward, cleaving to their old gods and loyalties. Some go strange, eventually raising their hand - or whatever's left - against all others.[PARAGRAPH:1]Ghostwalkers can undergo a different transformation with the Haunted Lands. They share out part of their own substance and humanity to the surrounding terrain, drinking from even more of the territory's inhuman nature. They become Haunts. Insubstantial, but hardly less terrible for that. Whip-fast, hard to see until it's right on top of you, a Haunt's airy frame can't take your head off, but this is hardly a comfort when it roars through your army and sinks it's claws into your skull.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Mending Nature[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Three Scion units create Haunted Lands.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][BOLD]Ghostwalkers[\BOLD] - With "Necromancy" a Ghostwalker may spend six turns creating a Haunted Lands. tile.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][BOLD]Reaching Creepers[\BOLD] - Any Creeper surviving a combat becomes swollen with blood and can put down roots and blossom into a Haunted Land tile. At the prompting of some uncanny cycle Creepers are spontaneously spawned within the Haunted Lands. Nature Mana perverted to Scion use increases the number of Creepers spawned, as does the number of Ghostwalkers and Redactors present in Erebus.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][BOLD]Redactors[\BOLD] - As soon as their available Redactors can create Haunted Lands. They transform not only their own tile, but those around them as well. The life within a forest or jungle may hold out for a time, but will succumb eventually.[PARAGRAPH:1]The mere existence of Ghostwalkers, Haunts, Redactors and the Black Lady allow Haunted Lands to spontaneously wrest themselves from non-existence. The more life, the more likely the transformation: Wooded areas are the most likely to change, Deserts the least. Haunts exert more influence than Ghostwalkers, and Redactors more than Haunts. The Black Lady doubles the odds of Haunted Lands appearing in this manner, and each node of Nature Mana has a similar if less dramatic influence.
