Whip-fast, hard to see until it's right on top of you, a Haunt's airy frame can't take your head off, but this is hardly a comfort when it roars through your army and sinks it's claws into your skull.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Mending Nature[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Three Scion units create Haunted Lands.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][BOLD]Ghostwalkers[\BOLD] - With "Necromancy" a Ghostwalker may spend six turns creating a Haunted Lands. tile.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][BOLD]Reaching Creepers[\BOLD] - Any Creeper surviving a combat becomes swollen with blood and can put down roots and blossom into a Haunted Land tile. At the prompting of some uncanny cycle Creepers are spontaneously spawned within the Haunted Lands. Nature Mana perverted to Scion use increases the number of Creepers spawned, as does the number of Ghostwalkers and Redactors present in Erebus.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][BOLD]Redactors[\BOLD] - As soon as their available Redactors can create Haunted Lands. They transform not only their own tile, but those around them as well. The life within a forest or jungle may hold out for a time, but will succumb eventually.[PARAGRAPH:1]The mere existence of Ghostwalkers, Haunts, Redactors and the Black Lady allow Haunted Lands to spontaneously wrest themselves from non-existence. The more life, the more likely the transformation: Wooded areas are the most likely to change, Deserts the least. Haunts exert more influence than Ghostwalkers, and Redactors more than Haunts. The Black Lady doubles the odds of Haunted Lands appearing in this manner, and each node of Nature Mana has a similar if less dramatic influence.
TEXT.German: [H1]The Haunted Lands[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]It is the nature of the world that everything is itself. This may seem a truism, but it does not hold in the Haunted Lands. The Haunted Lands join everything together, in the Haunted Lands things *blur*. Notably the line between death and life. There life, of a sort, is found in death and death, of a sort, is found in life.[PARAGRAPH:1]Eating anything grown within the Haunted Lands is very difficult. The grain may scream when harvested and make bread that crumbles into something like bone meal when baked. Its beer could taste and smell of nightmares. Cattle tend to be stillborn, which makes it all the more disturbing as the herds continue to grow.[PARAGRAPH:1]Nevertheless there is much wealth to be found in the Haunted Lands for the brave of heart and strong of stomach. Examples: A tree with branches that when aged and dried taste of nectar and honey, after being killed and cooked, of course. A stream lined with trainable, watchful stones. A pit full of knowledgeable darkness.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Use Haunted Lands to defend Patria Reborn or spoil the territories of your enemies. The Haunted Lands are not well suited to the living.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Undead have a natural affinity to the Haunted Lands. Their senses are sharpened, their arms strong. The Haunted Lands are also a source of many wonders... often grotesque or terrible. The useful ones can be kept or traded so others may appreciate the Gift. The useless ones - and there are many - can be a burden to any nearby living land. The Haunted Lands will foster Unhealth in nearby cities.[PARAGRAPH:1]Perhaps most disturbing, at least to those who haven't accepted the Emperor's Gift, is that those bearing wounds in the Haunted Lands do not always heal true. The substance of the Haunted Lands, or the lack thereof, enters their flesh. They become undead. Some carry on afterward, cleaving to their old gods and loyalties. TEXT.English: Deep jungle, Wetlands and Swamps
TEXT.French: Deep jungle, Wetlands and Swamps

TEXT.English: The Lizardman civilizations favour specific terrain types and gain unique benefits from them. Some of these terrain/feature types will only be found in their territory and will spread naturally over time. These are Deep Jungle (feature), Wetlands (terrain) and Swamp (improvement).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Deep Jungle feature replaces any natural jungle within a lizardman civilization's borders. It will revert to normal jungle once outside those borders. It does not convey the normal health and food penalties typically associated with jungle - in fact, it acts in a way very similar to a forest (providing bonus production and health). The only civilizations that will ever be able to benefit from this however are the Lizardmen. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Wetlands are a new base-terrain type which behave exactly like grassland, unless they are within Lizardman borders. If they are within such borders, any forest feature on a wetland tile will eventually convert to a deep jungle. Any wetland tile that has no bonus resource and no improvements on it may occasionally gain the swamp improvement for free and/or have deep jungle appear on it. Any grassland tile may become a wetland tile over time, though the process is much quicker in tiles that border rivers. Finally, wetland tiles allow units of the "Lizardkin" race to move faster through them.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Swamp improvement is an unpillagable, negative improvement for races without the Swampdwelling technology. For races with this technology however, it provides a number of benefits. Primarily, it provides additional food, with several techs that boost the food yield further. Additionally, it can provide commerce when combined with a trail. It can be created in tiles containing deep jungle, allowing it to also provide production. Swamps appear naturally in wetland tiles over time, or can be artificially created using the "Spring" spell on a wetland tile. They can be removed by using the "Scorch" spell (which reverts the tile back to basic grassland). They cannot exist in any tile other than wetland and so are also destroyed by conversion to hell-terrain. You cannot build any other improvement on top of a swamp, but it can co-exist with forest/jungle features.

TEXT.German: Die Echsenmenschen bevorzugen bestimmtes Terrain und erhalten einzigartige Boni auf ihnen. Einige dieser Geländearten und Ressourcen wird man nur auf ihrem Gebiet finden und verbreiten sich nach einiger Zeit von selbst. Das sind Tiefer Dschungel (Eigenschaft), Feuchtgebiet (Terrain) und Sumpf (Ausbau).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] Die Tiefe Dschungel Eigenschaft ersetzt alle natürlichen Dschungel innerhalb des Echsenmenschengebietes. Sie wird sich erst außerhalb deren Grenzen wieder durch normalen Dschungel zurückumwandeln. Tiefer Dschungel trägt nicht die üblicherweise mit Dschungel verknüpften Abzüge auf Gesundheit und Nahrung. Eigentlich verhält er sich diesbezüglich ähnlich wie Wald. Doch die einzigen Zivilisationen, die von ihm profitieren können, sind die der Echsenmenschen. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE] Feuchtgebiete sind neue Flachland-Geländearten, die sich genau wie Grasland verhalten, solange sie innerhalb der Gebiete der Echsenmenschen zu finden sind. Wenn sie in sich diesen Grenzen befinden, kann sich ein Wald, der auf einem Feuchtgebiet zu finden ist, unter Umständen zu einem Tiefen Dschungel werden. Jedes Feuchtgebiet, das keine Bonusressource und keine Ausbauten beinhaltet, erhält gelegentlich die Sumpfanbau Ausbauung oder eine Umwandlung zu Tiefem Dschungel. Jedes Graslandfeld kann ein Feuchtgebietfeld werden, wobei natürlich diese Umwandlung schneller bei an Flüssen gelegenen Feldern schneller vonstatten gehen kann. Außerdem kommen alle Echsenmenschen Einheiten auf Feuchtgebiet schneller voran.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] Sumpfausbau ist für Rassen ohne ohne den Sumpfbau-Fortschritt unplünderbare, negative Ausbauten. Für die anderen erzeugt er jedoch eine Reihe von interessanten Vorteilen. Zu Beginn liefert der Sumpfausbau zusätzliche Nahrung, deren Ertrag durch zusätzliche Technologien noch erhöht werden kann. Durch einen Sumpfpfad kann auch Geld erzeugt werden. Sumpfausbau kann auf Feldern mit Tiefem Dschungel angelegt werden, so daß auch Produktion gesteigert werden. Sümpfe erscheinen natürlicherweise nach einiger Zeit in. Die Echsenmenschen bevorzugen bestimmtes Terrain und erhalten einzigartige Boni auf ihnen. Einige dieser Geländearten und Ressourcen wird man nur auf ihrem Gebiet finden und verbreiten sich nach einiger Zeit von selbst. Das sind Tiefer Dschungel (Eigenschaft), Feuchtgebiet (Terrain) und Sumpf (Ausbau).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] Die Tiefe Dschungel Eigenschaft ersetzt alle natürlichen Dschungel innerhalb des Echsenmenschengebietes. Sie wird sich erst außerhalb deren Gr Feuchtgebieten oder können künstlich durch den "Quelle"-Zauber angelegt werden. Sie können durch den "Verbrennen"-Zauber trockengelegt werden (Grasland ensteht). Sie gibt es nur auf Feuchtgebietfeldern und werden durch die Umwandlung zu Höllengebiet zerstört. Außer Sumpf kann man keine andere Bewirtschaftung auf diesem Terrain erzeugen, er kann aber sehr wohl mit Dschungel oder Wald Eigenschaften gemeinsam vorliegen.

TEXT.English: Elohim - Keepers of Sacred Places
TEXT.French: Elohim - Keepers of Sacred Places

TEXT.English: [H1]Keepers of Sacred Places[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Elohim are the Keepers of Sacred Places. As such, for each of the unique features they have within their borders, they get a different blessing. To assist them with this endeavor, they will start the game by knowing the location of all unique features on the map. The following is a list of what each unique feature provides:[NEWLINE] [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_AIFON_ISLE]Aifon Isle[\LINK] - Keepers of Danalin's Sorrow: +25% [ICON_COMMERCE] from [ICON_TRADE]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BAIR_OF_LACUNA]Bair of Lacuna[\LINK] - Keepers of the Undying's Lair: +20% Ritual Production in All Cities. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BRADELINES_WELL]Bradeline's Well[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_WELL]Keepers of the Underworld's Gate[\LINK]: Disciple and Arcane units gain +30% vs Demon. If it could be purified, however... [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BROKEN_SEPULCHER]Broken Sepulcher[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_SEPULCHER]Keepers of Death's Shattered Jail[\LINK]: All combat units gain +25% Resistance to Death Damage, and -25% to Enemy Withdrawal Chance. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CLIFFS_OF_TALI]Cliffs of Kelle[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_TALI]Keepers of Storm's Crag[\LINK]: Commander, Recon, and Rogue units gain +25% Chance to Avoid Bad Lair Results and +25% Withdrawal Chance. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CLOCKWORK_TOWER]Clockwork City[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_CLOCKWORK]Keepers of the Mechanical Marvel[\LINK]: Siege units recieve +1 Range, +3 Ranged Strength, +15% Ranged Damage Limit, and Magic Immunity. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_DRAGON_BONES]Dragon Bones[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_BONES]Keepers of the Giant Skull[\LINK]: Melee and Defensive Melee Units gain +25% vs Animal and Beast Units, and capture defeated Beast Units. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_FOXFORD]Foxford[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_FOXFORD]Keepers of the Howling Hamlet[\LINK]: Animal, Beast, and Melee Units get +2 First Strike Chances and +25% vs Animal, Beast, Melee, and Defensive Melee Units. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_GUARDIAN]Guardian of the Pristin Pass[\LINK] - Keepers of Stone Guardians: Free [LINK=BUILDING_PRISTIN_GUARDIAN]Pristin Guardian Building[\LINK] in Every City (+25% Defense, -25% Damage From Bombardment) and all non-animal combat units gain [LINK=PROMOTION_LIGHTNING_RESISTANCE]Resist Lightning[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_LETUM_FRIGUS]Letum Frigus[\LINK] - Keepers of Winter's End: +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] from [LINK=TERRAIN_TAIGA]Taiga[\LINK], +1 [ICON_FOOD] from [LINK=TERRAIN_TUNDRA]Tundra[\LINK], and all non-animal combat units gain [LINK=PROMOTION_COLD_RESISTANCE]Resist Cold[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MAELSTROM]Maelstrom[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_MAELSTROM]Keepers of the Maelstrom[\LINK]: All Naval and Rogue Units gain +1 movement. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MIRROR_OF_HEAVEN]Mirror of Heaven[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_MIRROR]Keepers of the Heavenly Mirror[\LINK]: +1 [ICON_FOOD] and [ICON_COMMERCE] from [LINK=FEATURE_OASIS]Oasis[\LINK]. Commander, Disciple, and Recon Units gain +1 Visibility Range and Perception. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MOUNT_KALSHEKK]Mount Kalshekk[\LINK] - Keepers of Earth's Fiery Heart: +1 [ICON_FOOD], [ICON_PRODUCTION], and [ICON_COMMERCE] from Jungle. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_ODIOS_PRISON]Odio's Prison[\LINK] - Keepers of Contained Wrath: All units gain +1 XP from combat. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_POOL_OF_TEARS]Pool of Tears[\LINK] - Keepers of the Waters of Birth: All cities gain +4 [ICON_HEALTHY], and all non-animal combat units gain [LINK=PROMOTION_POISON_RESISTANCE]Resist Poison[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_PYRE_OF_THE_SERAPHIC]Pyre of the Seraphic[\LINK] - Keepers of the Eternal Fire: +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] and [ICON_COMMERCE] from [LINK=TERRAIN_BURNING_SANDS]burning sands[\LINK], and all non-animal combat units gain [LINK=PROMOTION_FIRE_RESISTANCE]Resist Fire[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_REMNANTS_OF_PATRIA]Remnants of Patria[\LINK] - Keepers of Mankind's Ruins: -20% Maintenance Costs from Distance to Palace. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_RING_OF_CARCER]Ring of Carcer[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_CARCER]Keepers of the Frozen Passion[\LINK]: +15% XP Gain for all units. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_RINWELL]Rinwell Isle[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_RINWELL]Keepers of the Dead Island[\LINK]: +1 [ICON_FOOD] on [LINK=TERRAIN_MARSH]marsh[\LINK] and [LINK=TERRAIN_SHALLOWS]shallows[\LINK], all combat units lose amphibious assault penalties, and gain +25% Resistance to Death Damage. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_SEVEN_PINES]Seven Pines[\LINK] - Keepers of the Lost Peace: +10% [ICON_CULTURE] and [ICON_RESEARCH] when at peace. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_SIRONAS_BEACON]Sirona's Beacon[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_SIRONA]Keepers of Mercy's Light[\LINK]: [LINK=AFFINITY_KEEPERS_SIRONA]Each Spirit Mana[\LINK] gives Disciple Units +5% Heal Rate, +0.5% XP Rate, +0.5 Holy Damage, and +10% Resistance to Unholy Damage. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_STANDING_STONES]Standing Stones[\LINK] - Keepers of Earth's Memento: +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] on Plots with 3 [ICON_PRODUCTION]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_TOMB_OF_SUCELLUS]Tomb of Sucellus[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_SUCELLUS]Keepers of Nature's Grave[\LINK]: All units gain +10% Heal Rate and +5% Healing After Combat. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_TOWER_OF_EYES]Tower of Eyes[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_EYES]Keepers of the Madman's Cell[\LINK]: All non-animal combat units gain [LINK=PROMOTION_MAGIC_RESISTANCE]Resist Magic[\LINK], and all units are immune to capture. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_WELL_OF_SOULS]Blocked Well of Souls[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_SOULS]Keepers of the Barred Procession[\LINK]: +1 [ICON_FOOD], [ICON_PRODUCTION], and [ICON_COMMERCE] on [LINK=TERRAIN_WASTELAND]wasteland[\LINK], and combat units gain +15% vs Undead. If it could be unbarred however... [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_YGGDRASIL]Yggdrasil[\LINK] - Keepers of the Sacred Tree: +1 [ICON_FOOD] on Plots with 3 [ICON_FOOD].[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]With the Magister Ashes module enabled, the following unique features and blessings may be available: [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_ABADDONS_PIT]Abaddon's Pit[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_ABADDON]Keepers of the Locust's Jail[\LINK]: Disciple, Defensive Melee, and Worker units gain double fortification bonus, +1 Visibility Range and Perception. +1 [ICON_FOOD], [ICON_PRODUCTION] and [ICON_COMMERCE] on [LINK=TERRAIN_BROKEN_LANDS]Broken Lands[\LINK] and [LINK=TERRAIN_FIELDS_OF_PERDITION]Fields of Perdition[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BADBS_BLIZZARD]Blizzard's Castle[\LINK] - Keepers of the Eternal Blizzard: Arcane and Rogue units gain [LINK=PROMOTION_COLD_STRENGTH]+1 Cold Strength[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CARNIVEANS_CAMP]Carnivean's Camp[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_CARNIVEAN]Keepers of the Long Odds[\LINK]: Arcane and Melee units gain +25% Withdrawal Chance. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_GRAVE_OF_ASMODAY]Grave of Asmoday[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_ASMODAY]Keepers of the Lord of Dust's Tomb[\LINK]: Animal, Beast, Melee, Naval, and Siege units gain +2 Collateral Damage Targets and +20% Collateral Damage Limit. Whispers beckon... [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MAJENS_WORKSHOP]Majen's Workshop[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_MAJEN]Keepers of the Tinkerer's Trove[\LINK]: +1 [ICON_HAPPY] and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] per city. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_WHISPERING_WOOD]Whispering Woods[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_WHISPERING]Keepers of the Veil of Shadows[\LINK]: Arcane, Commander, Rogue, and Worker units gain +3 Perception and Ignore Terrain Movement Costs.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Beware, however: Should the watchers against corruption themselves fall to its seductive power, their blessings may falter, or twist...
TEXT.French: [H1]Keepers of Sacred Places[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Elohim are the Keepers of Sacred Places. As such, for each of the unique features they have within their borders, they get a different blessing. To assist them with this endeavor, they will start the game by knowing the location of all unique features on the map. The following is a list of what each unique feature provides:[NEWLINE] [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_AIFON_ISLE]Aifon Isle[\LINK] - Keepers of Danalin's Sorrow: +25% [ICON_COMMERCE] from [ICON_TRADE]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BAIR_OF_LACUNA]Bair of Lacuna[\LINK] - Keepers of the Undying's Lair: +20% Ritual Production in All Cities. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BRADELINES_WELL]Bradeline's Well[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_WELL]Keepers of the Underworld's Gate[\LINK]: Disciple and Arcane units gain +30% vs Demon. If it could be purified, however... [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BROKEN_SEPULCHER]Broken Sepulcher[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_SEPULCHER]Keepers of Death's Shattered Jail[\LINK]: All combat units gain +25% Resistance to Death Damage, and -25% to Enemy Withdrawal Chance. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CLIFFS_OF_TALI]Cliffs of Kelle[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_TALI]Keepers of Storm's Crag[\LINK]: Commander, Recon, and Rogue units gain +25% Chance to Avoid Bad Lair Results and +25% Withdrawal Chance. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CLOCKWORK_TOWER]Clockwork City[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_CLOCKWORK]Keepers of the Mechanical Marvel[\LINK]: Siege units recieve +1 Range, +3 Ranged Strength, +15% Ranged Damage Limit, and Magic Immunity. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_DRAGON_BONES]Dragon Bones[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_BONES]Keepers of the Giant Skull[\LINK]: Melee and Defensive Melee Units gain +25% vs Animal and Beast Units, and capture defeated Beast Units. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_FOXFORD]Foxford[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_FOXFORD]Keepers of the Howling Hamlet[\LINK]: Animal, Beast, and Melee Units get +2 First Strike Chances and +25% vs Animal, Beast, Melee, and Defensive Melee Units. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_GUARDIAN]Guardian of the Pristin Pass[\LINK] - Keepers of Stone Guardians: Free [LINK=BUILDING_PRISTIN_GUARDIAN]Pristin Guardian Building[\LINK] in Every City (+25% Defense, -25% Damage From Bombardment) and all non-animal combat units gain [LINK=PROMOTION_LIGHTNING_RESISTANCE]Resist Lightning[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_LETUM_FRIGUS]Letum Frigus[\LINK] - Keepers of Winter's End: +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] from [LINK=TERRAIN_TAIGA]Taiga[\LINK], +1 [ICON_FOOD] from [LINK=TERRAIN_TUNDRA]Tundra[\LINK], and all non-animal combat units gain [LINK=PROMOTION_COLD_RESISTANCE]Resist Cold[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MAELSTROM]Maelstrom[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_MAELSTROM]Keepers of the Maelstrom[\LINK]: All Naval and Rogue Units gain +1 movement. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MIRROR_OF_HEAVEN]Mirror of Heaven[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_MIRROR]Keepers of the Heavenly Mirror[\LINK]: +1 [ICON_FOOD] and [ICON_COMMERCE] from [LINK=FEATURE_OASIS]Oasis[\LINK]. Commander, Disciple, and Recon Units gain +1 Visibility Range and Perception. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_GUARDIAN]Guardian of the Pristin Pass[\LINK] - Keepers of Stone Guardians: Free [LINK=BUILDING_PRISTIN_GUARDIAN]Pristin Guardian Building[\LINK] in Every City (+25% Defense, -25% Damage From Bombardment) and all non-animal combat units gain [LINK=PROMOTION_LIGHTNING_RESISTANCE]Resist Lightning[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_LETUM_FRIGUS]Letum Frigus[\LINK] - Keepers of Winter's End: +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] from [LINK=TERRAIN_TAIGA]Taiga[\LINK], +1 [ICON_FOOD] from [LINK=TERRAIN_TUNDRA]Tundra[\LINK], and all non-animal combat units gain [LINK=PROMOTION_COLD_RESISTANCE]Resist Cold[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MAELSTROM]Maelstrom[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_MAELSTROM]Keepers of the Maelstrom[\LINK]: All Naval and Rogue Units gain +1 movement. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MIRROR_OF_HEAVEN]Mirror of Heaven[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_MIRROR]Keepers of the Heavenly Mirror[\LINK]: +1 [ICON_FOOD] and [ICON_COMMERCE] from [LINK=FEATURE_OASIS]Oasis[\LINK]. Commander, Disciple, and Recon Units gain +1 Visibility Range and Perception. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MOUNT_KALSHEKK]Mount Kalshekk[\LINK] - Keepers of Earth's Fiery Heart: +1 [ICON_FOOD], [ICON_PRODUCTION], and [ICON_COMMERCE] from Jungle. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_ODIOS_PRISON]Odio's Prison[\LINK] - Keepers of Contained Wrath: All units gain +1 XP from combat. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_POOL_OF_TEARS]Pool of Tears[\LINK] - Keepers of the Waters of Birth: All cities gain +4 [ICON_HEALTHY], and all non-animal combat units gain [LINK=PROMOTION_POISON_RESISTANCE]Resist Poison[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_PYRE_OF_THE_SERAPHIC]Pyre of the Seraphic[\LINK] - Keepers of the Eternal Fire: +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] and [ICON_COMMERCE] from [LINK=TERRAIN_BURNING_SANDS]burning sands[\LINK], and all non-animal combat units gain [LINK=PROMOTION_FIRE_RESISTANCE]Resist Fire[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_REMNANTS_OF_PATRIA]Remnants of Patria[\LINK] - Keepers of Mankind's Ruins: -20% Maintenance Costs from Distance to Palace. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_RING_OF_CARCER]Ring of Carcer[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_CARCER]Keepers of the Frozen Passion[\LINK]: +15% XP Gain for all units. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_RINWELL]Rinwell Isle[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_RINWELL]Keepers of the Dead Island[\LINK]: +1 [ICON_FOOD] on [LINK=TERRAIN_MARSH]marsh[\LINK] and [LINK=TERRAIN_SHALLOWS]shallows[\LINK], all combat units lose amphibious assault penalties, and gain +25% Resistance to Death Damage. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_SEVEN_PINES]Seven Pines[\LINK] - Keepers of the Lost Peace: +10% [ICON_CULTURE] and [ICON_RESEARCH] when at peace. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_SIRONAS_BEACON]Sirona's Beacon[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_SIRONA]Keepers of Mercy's Light[\LINK]: [LINK=AFFINITY_KEEPERS_SIRONA]Each Spirit Mana[\LINK] gives Disciple Units +5% Heal Rate, +0.5% XP Rate, +0.5 Holy Damage, and +10% Resistance to Unholy Damage. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_STANDING_STONES]Standing Stones[\LINK] - Keepers of Earth's Memento: +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] on Plots with 3 [ICON_PRODUCTION]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_TOMB_OF_SUCELLUS]Tomb of Sucellus[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_SUCELLUS]Keepers of Nature's Grave[\LINK]: All units gain +10% Heal Rate and +5% Healing After Combat. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_TOWER_OF_EYES]Tower of Eyes[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_EYES]Keepers of the Madman's Cell[\LINK]: All non-animal combat units gain [LINK=PROMOTION_MAGIC_RESISTANCE]Resist Magic[\LINK], and all units are immune to capture. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_WELL_OF_SOULS]Blocked Well of Souls[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_SOULS]Keepers of the Barred Procession[\LINK]: +1 [ICON_FOOD], [ICON_PRODUCTION], and [ICON_COMMERCE] on [LINK=TERRAIN_WASTELAND]wasteland[\LINK], and combat units gain +15% vs Undead. If it could be unbarred however... [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_YGGDRASIL]Yggdrasil[\LINK] - Keepers of the Sacred Tree: +1 [ICON_FOOD] on Plots with 3 [ICON_FOOD].[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]With the Magister Ashes module enabled, the following unique features and blessings may be available: [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_ABADDONS_PIT]Abaddon's Pit[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_ABADDON]Keepers of the Locust's Jail[\LINK]: Disciple, Defensive Melee, and Worker units gain double fortification bonus, +1 Visibility Range and Perception. +1 [ICON_FOOD], [ICON_PRODUCTION] and [ICON_COMMERCE] on [LINK=TERRAIN_BROKEN_LANDS]Broken Lands[\LINK] and [LINK=TERRAIN_FIELDS_OF_PERDITION]Fields of Perdition[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BADBS_BLIZZARD]Blizzard's Castle[\LINK] - Keepers of the Eternal Blizzard: Arcane and Rogue units gain [LINK=PROMOTION_COLD_STRENGTH]+1 Cold Strength[\LINK]. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CARNIVEANS_CAMP]Carnivean's Camp[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_CARNIVEAN]Keepers of the Long Odds[\LINK]: Arcane and Melee units gain +25% Withdrawal Chance. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_GRAVE_OF_ASMODAY]Grave of Asmoday[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_ASMODAY]Keepers of the Lord of Dust's Tomb[\LINK]: Animal, Beast, Melee, Naval, and Siege units gain +2 Collateral Damage Targets and +20% Collateral Damage Limit. Whispers beckon... [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MAJENS_WORKSHOP]Majen's Workshop[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_MAJEN]Keepers of the Tinkerer's Trove[\LINK]: +1 [ICON_HAPPY] and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] per city. [ICON_BULLET][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_WHISPERING_WOOD]Whispering Woods[\LINK] - [LINK=PROMOTION_KEEPERS_WHISPERING]Keepers of the Veil of Shadows[\LINK]: Arcane, Commander, Rogue, and Worker units gain +3 Perception and Ignore Terrain Movement Costs.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Beware, however: Should the watchers against corruption themselves fall to its seductive power, their blessings may falter, or twist...

TEXT.English: Golem Upgrades
TEXT.French: Golem Upgrades

TEXT.English: [H1]Golem Upgrades:[\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE][PARAGRAPH:1]Once the Luchuirp civilisation has reached Lv:2 on their civilisation trait, they are then able to augment their (non-worker) golems with promotions, as long as they have access to the associated mana type. Each golem can only have one upgrade at a time, but you can freely change them in cities. [NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Law Mana: [LINK=PROMOTION_GOLEM_UPGRADE_LAW_CAPTAIN_GOLEMS]Enhanced Patrol Routines[\LINK] - Unit guards against enemy marksman units. Helpful to escort support units like adepts or siege.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Life Mana: [LINK=PROMOTION_GOLEM_UPGRADE_LIFE_CAPTAIN_GOLEMS]Banishing Blades[\LINK] - Increased strength and converts some strength to holy, as well as a bonus against undead. Holy damage is extra effective against demons and undead, but weaker against angels.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Mind Mana: [LINK=PROMOTION_GOLEM_UPGRADE_MIND_CAPTAIN_GOLEMS]Enhanced Cognition[\LINK] - 1 first strike. A universally useful combat enhancement.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Sun Mana: [LINK=PROMOTION_GOLEM_UPGRADE_SUN_CAPTAIN_GOLEMS]Truth Lenses[\LINK] - Increased perception and vision. Useful for scouting and spotting stealth units like thieves.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Force Mana: [LINK=PROMOTION_GOLEM_UPGRADE_FORCE_CAPTAIN_GOLEMS]Suppression Field[\LINK] - Golem gains an aura promotion that inflicts the [LINK=PROMOTION_SLOW]Slow[\LINK] promotion on nearby enemies, reducing their movement and withdrawal chance. Helpful for catching fast units like cavalry.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Nature Mana: [LINK=PROMOTION_GOLEM_UPGRADE_NATURE_CAPTAIN_GOLEMS]Taming Nets[\LINK] - Increased strength against animals and beasts, as well as the ability to capture animals.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Air Mana: [LINK=PROMOTION_GOLEM_UPGRADE_AIR_CAPTAIN_GOLEMS]Lightning Charged Coils[\LINK] - Increased strength and converts some strength to lightning, as well as a small collateral damage boost. Lightning damage is extra effective against units with metal weapon promotions.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Earth Mana: [LINK=PROMOTION_GOLEM_UPGRADE_EARTH_CAPTAIN_GOLEMS]Heavy Frame[\LINK] - Increased defensive strength, but increased movement cost. Great for golems to guard your cities and forts.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Fire Mana: [LINK=PROMOTION_GOLEM_UPGRADE_FIRE_CAPTAIN_GOLEMS]Flamespewers[\LINK] - Increased strength and converts some strength to fire, increased attack against cities, but reduced defence. Fire damage is weaker against lizardmen and demons and much weaker against orcs, but very effective against Trolls, Frostlings, Treants, and Drown.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Water Mana: [LINK=PROMOTION_GOLEM_UPGRADE_WATER_CAPTAIN_GOLEMS]Hydro Traversal[\LINK] - Golems can move on water, suffer no penalties from amphibious landings or crossing rivers, and doubled movement on coasts. Use it to quickly move about coastal parts of your empire, or to clear nearby islands of pesky barbarians and ships.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Chaos Mana: [LINK=PROMOTION_GOLEM_UPGRADE_CHAOS_CAPTAIN_GOLEMS]Scything Blade Attachments [\LINK] - Increased strength in forests, and against melee units. Use on enemies with many melee units, or in areas with many forests, such as the territory of elven civs.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Shadow Mana: [LINK=PROMOTION_GOLEM_UPGRADE_SHADOW_CAPTAIN_GOLEMS]Displacement Field[\LINK] - Immunity to first strikes, and a small strength increase against archers. Helpful anywhere you expect to see many archers, such as when you are attacking cities.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Metamagic Mana: [LINK=PROMOTION_GOLEM_UPGRADE_METAMAGIC_CAPTAIN_GOLEMS]Magic Proof Plating[\LINK] - Resistance to elemental damage and high spell resistance. Useful when your foes have many arcane or disciple units.

Lightning damage is extra effective against units with metal weapon promotions.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Earth Mana: [LINK=PROMOTION_GOLEM_UPGRADE_EARTH_CAPTAIN_GOLEMS]Heavy Frame[\LINK] - Increased defensive strength, but increased movement cost. TEXT.French: Dictionnaire

TEXT.English: Additional Useful Hotkeys
TEXT.French: Additional Useful Hotkeys

TEXT.English:
Ashes of Erebus has additional hotkey functions for extra quality of life.
[ICON_BULLET] ALT X, City Planner. Shows an outline on your cursor of how many tiles would fit inside the big fat cross of a city to better plan where to send your settlers. [ICON_BULLET] SHIFT X with City Planner already turned on, change the size of the City Planner borders. [ICON_BULLET]CTRL X with City Planner already turned on, allows you to click on the world to place markers for future reference, which can be hidden again with CTRL X. Click on a marker again to remove it.
[ICON_BULLET]SHIFT ALT R, Popup Reminder: allows you to punch in a text reminder for yourself that will pop up in X number of turns to help you remember your plans for that game session. The reminder will appear as yellow text in the chat window and will play a sound.

TEXT.English: Chislev - The Council (Dynamic Leader)
TEXT.French: Chislev - The Council (Dynamic Leader)

TEXT.English:
[H1]The Council:[\H1][PARAGRAPH:2][LINK=LEADER_THE_COUNCIL]The Council[\LINK] is a new emergent leader, but doesn't level up a single trait, as other emergent leaders do. Instead, the Council is constantly vying for the favour of the seven tribes. They do not participate in tribal elections while under the Tribal Law civic, but most of your in-game actions will affect your relations with one of the tribes, and if a particular tribe likes you enough, they'll join the council (represented by earning a unique trait). Favour with all tribes will decrease over time, but whenever a tribe joins, you get a small buffer window so that they won't leave you right after joining you.
[BOLD]Eagle [ICON_BULLET]Likes workers and growing cities. [ICON_BULLET]Dislikes war.
[BOLD]Deer [ICON_BULLET]Likes hunting and defending your lands from enemies. [ICON_BULLET]Dislikes war.
[BOLD]Bear [ICON_BULLET]Likes culture growth and constructing buildings. [ICON_BULLET]Dislikes war.
[BOLD]Wolf [ICON_BULLET]Likes fighting and raiding. [ICON_BULLET]Dislikes peace.
[BOLD]Long Hair [ICON_BULLET]Likes spellcasters and great persons. [ICON_BULLET]Dislikes peace.
[BOLD]Three Sisters [ICON_BULLET]Likes trading. [ICON_BULLET]Dislikes war.
[BOLD]Sky [ICON_BULLET]Likes religion, culture and constructing buildings.
